detail_list.name: The Mountain

technique.fertiliser_weekly: Interpet Liquid Plant Food (4x Pumps Daily)

descriptions: A prominent, triangular shaped mountain “peek” has been positioned in the center of the aquascape (slightly angled to one side) along with Anubias planted along the bottom edge line. This was to create a raised mountain look within a jungle style surrounding. Six smaller grey mountain rocks surround the mountain peak, with groups of Helanthium planted in-between with plenty of space in the foreground to grow into. Four more rocks were used on the outer sections, then in the background and side spaces we used a variety of Cryptocorynes, Echinodorus & Microsorum.

Finished with two varieties of Taxiphyllum. The aquarium itself is a classic furniture style setup with an Interpet Aqua Smart LED retro fitted into the hood for illumination, this is controlled via the Aqua Smart App. Filtration is an Interpet corner power filter 3 (600 lph) and a Interpet 200w Deltatherm heater. A layer of Tropica soil power was used as the base, then evenly covered with Amtra River Sand & Gravel. Pressurised CO2 was also used at 15mg/L and Interpet liquid plant food (4x pumps a day).

technique_cn.fertiliser_weekly: 每周使用 4 次 Interpet 液体植物肥料。

descriptions_cn: 一个三角形的山峰被放置在造景中心（略微倾斜），并在底部边缘种植了袖珍小榕。这样营造出了一座山峰在丛林风格环境中的突出效果。六块灰色的小山石围绕着山峰，中间种植了针叶皇冠草，前景留有足够的空间让它们生长。在造景的外侧使用了四块石头，背景和侧面则种植了多种椒草、皇冠草和铁皇冠。

完成作品使用了两种Taxiphyllum 属莫丝。造景本身是经典的家具风格，顶部安装了一个Interpet Aqua Smart LED灯，通过Aqua Smart App控制。过滤系统为Interpet角落增压过滤器3（600升/小时）和一个Interpet 200瓦Deltatherm加热器。底床使用了Tropica土壤基底，然后均匀覆盖了Amtra河砂和砾石。还使用了加压CO₂，剂量为15mg/L，以及Interpet液体植物肥料（每天4次泵送）。

detail_list.name: Breezy
descriptions: "A simple 4-stone layout using plants that can thrive in a low-tech setting. The substrate includes aquasoil bottom capped with sand and stocked with Japan Blue-Lyretail Guppies. 6 hours of light per day, one 50% water change per week keeps the layout growing at a manageable pace."
said DouMing Mok

technique_cn.fertiliser_weekly: 每周施用 Tropica 专用肥 8ml。

descriptions_cn: 这是一个使用低技术设置下也能茁壮生长的植物打造的四石造景。底床采用水草泥打底，上面覆盖一层化妆砂，并饲养了日本蓝丽仔孔雀鱼。每天提供6小时光照，每周进行一次50%的换水，使造景保持在一个可控的生长速度。
DouMing Mok 说

detail_list.name: Classical Nature

technique.decoration: Locally sourced stones nad red moor wood

descriptions: I made this aquarium for my friend who asked me to make “winter hotel” for the huge amount of fish living outside in his garden pond during summer. It is mixture of all kinds livebearers (Gupies, Platies, Red swordtails, Black Molly, etc. ) and therefore we had to approach this task accordingly. As a base for our project we used JUWEL RIO 350 Aquarium set. This type of set contain an aquarium with a built in filter and light. The lights and filtration are quite simple but as you can see, when you choose right plants, substrate and add pressurised CO2 you can achieve nice healthy growth. As substrate I used Tropica aquarium soil and small amount of decorative sand used in the foreground. The and is a mixture of Dennerle Crystal Quartz sand and different variations of the sand from hobby market. Stones were taken from a nearby mine which saved us significant amount of money. In local hobby market we also purchased 3 bold mangrove roots, which are fill the space in aquarium nicely. Don't be afraid to go big with hardscape, it gives nice character to overall picture. If you have so many livebearers with fast rate of reproducing you should reflect it in your plant selection and fertilser regime. This is why I selected easy and fast growing plants, all this fast plant growth is helping with filtration in this heavily stocked tank. It turned out to be right solution and even with the basic build in filter we don’t have issue to keep the aquarium clean and healthy. Down side of using fast growing plants is that they must be cut more often. On the other hand cuttings can be planted back to aquarium and help with filtration. Regular water changes and glass cleaning are must have, but that maintenance routine applies for all aquariums. In a temporary winter storage for pond fish like this, which will be taken down at the end of the winter it is not necessary to fertilse the plants as they will receive nitrates as a biproduct of the fish and fish food waste.
Said Jan Marsal

technique_cn.decoration: 本地采购的石头和红木
technique_cn.fertiliser_weekly: 每周施用 3 次 Specialised Nutrition 肥料。

descriptions_cn: 我为朋友打造了一个“冬季酒店”水族箱，用于容纳他花园池塘中夏季生活的大量鱼。这些鱼主要是各种种类的胎生鱼（如孔雀鱼、月光鱼、红剑尾鱼、黑玛丽鱼等）。因此，我们采用了相应的处理方法。我们的项目基础是 JUWEL RIO 350 水族箱套装。这种套装包含内置过滤器和灯光。灯光和过滤器虽然简单，但选择合适的植物、底床和加入加压 CO₂ 后，可以实现健康的生长。底床使用了特罗皮卡温蒂椒草水草泥，并在前景中加入了一点点装饰砂。装饰砂是由 Dennerle 颗粒水晶石和市场上不同种类的砂子混合而成。石头是从附近矿山采集的，这为我们节省了一大笔费用。在本地水族市场，我们还购买了 3 根粗壮的红树根，它们在水族箱中填充了空间。不要害怕在骨架上做得大一些，它会给整体画面增添很好的特色。如果你有很多胎生鱼并且繁殖速度快，那么在植物选择和施肥方面也应该有所体现。因此，我选择了易于快速生长的植物，这些快速生长的植物有助于过滤这个高密度鱼缸中的水。结果证明这是一个正确的解决方案，即使使用内置过滤器，我们也能保持水族箱的清洁和健康。快速生长植物的一个缺点是需要更频繁地修剪。另一方面，剪下的部分可以重新种植回水族箱中，帮助过滤。定期换水和玻璃清洁是必须的，但这种维护程序适用于所有水族箱。对于像这样的池塘鱼临时冬季储藏，水族箱在冬季结束时会被拆除，因此不需要对植物进行施肥，因为鱼和鱼食废物会提供足够的氮肥。
Jan Marsal 说

detail_list.name: Winter Hotel
descriptions: "This aquarium belongs to a gentleman who retired from his daily work and wanted to replace his old-style fish tank with a modern nature aquarium. Maintenance of the previous aquarium was very time-consuming and the constant battle with algae was very tiring, we, therefore, decided to make a complete rescape.

For the substrate, we choose to go with Tropica aquarium soil and small amounts of decorative sand, used in the foreground. Sand consists of a mixture of Dennerle Crystal Quartz sand and different variations of the sands from the hobby market. Stones were taken from a nearby mine which saved us a significant amount of money, due to the size of the tank and the fact that stones are one of the most expensive things in the hobby. For the hardscape, we chose 3 pcs. of red moor wood, mainly because this type of wood provides you with great details without too much effort.

The main goal of this rescape was to achieve a stable long-term nature aquarium with little to no maintenance required, on top of the routine water changes. That's why we went with plants in the easy and medium categories, focusing mainly on the easy ones. We also avoided stem plants, simply because easy-category stem plants require loads of trimming. We also set up a new easy maintenance routine, replacing the “bucket method” with the “hose, pump, bucket in the sink method”. The pump makes your maintenance routine quick and painless, I would highly recommend it to everyone with tanks above 60l."
Said Jan Marsal

technique_cn.decoration: 本地采购的石头 + 沙漠木

descriptions_cn: 这位先生退休后，想用一个现代自然水族造景缸取代旧式的鱼缸。之前水族造景缸的维护非常耗时，与藻类的斗争也让人疲惫不堪，所以我们决定进行全面的水草造景改造。
底床使用了 Tropica 水草泥和少量的化妆砂，用于前景。化妆砂由 Dennerle 颗粒水晶石和市场上不同种类的砂子混合而成。石头来自附近的一个矿场，由于缸体较大且石头是造景中最贵的材料之一，所以节省了一笔不小的费用。硬景选择了 3 块红棕木，因为这种木材提供了丰富的细节而不需要太多加工。
这次水草造景的主要目标是创造一个长期稳定且几乎不需要额外维护的自然水族箱，除了常规的换水。因此，我们选择了易于管理和中等难度的植物，主要集中在易于管理的种类上。我们还避免使用有茎草，因为这类有茎草需要频繁修剪。我们还制定了新的易于维护的程序，用“水管、水泵、水桶在水槽中”的方法取代了“桶法”。水泵让维护变得快速而轻松，我强烈推荐这种方法给所有缸体容量超过60升的水族爱好者。
Jan Marsal 说

detail_list.name: Layout 127 - Within the flow
descriptions: "With this scape I wanted to prove myself that everything can be made when you only want to. I found inspiration in an aquascaping book and thought that this might be hard to copy but I wanted to give it a try. The easier part was the submerged area with plants that easily assimilate under water. For the terrestrial part it was hard to find the perfect plants. I wanted to grow Bolbitis but I found out that it might take forever. Besides Bolbitits I wanted to have some Anubias species arround the wood reaching above the surface. I couldn't find the one that was mentioned in the book and went for Agustifolia instead. In the beginning I tryed to cover the emersed plants with foil to prevent them from drying out but even after a few month the leafs suffered from the dry air of my flat. In the back of the tank I used wabikusa balls that I planted with Echinodorus Rose and Hygrophila corymbosa. That plant really went wild and grew out crazily but I decided to take it out for the final shot of the tank. I highly recommend this plant if you want to achieve a wild jungle look above the watersurface."
said Fabian Beck
descriptions_cn: 这是我想要证明自己能够完成任何造景的作品。我在一本造景书中找到了灵感，虽然觉得复制可能会很难，但我还是想试一试。水下部分相对容易，因为有许多植物可以在水中快速生长。但对于陆生部分，我很难找到合适的植物。我原本想种植黑木蕨，但发现它可能需要很长时间才能适应。除了黑木蕨，我还想在木头上种植一些水榕属植物，使其生长到水面以上。我在书中找不到那种水榕，最终选择了狭叶水榕。起初，我用锡箔纸覆盖陆生植物以防止它们干燥，但即使过了几个月，叶片还是受到了室内干燥空气的影响。在缸后部，我使用了瓦布卡斯球，种植了玫瑰皇冠草和大柳。那植物生长得非常旺盛，疯狂地向外扩展，最终我还是决定移除它，以获得最终的造景效果。我强烈推荐这种植物，如果你想要达到水面以上野生丛林的效果。
Fabian Beck 说

detail_list.name: L126 - Großer Rettenstein
descriptions: "This tank and planting came in two stages. The first stage was a "plants and stones only" layout. After I took a first picture for the European "WebAquascapingContest" I changed the tank, took out some plants and added cosmetic sand. I used some crushed stones do build details and added a few species arround the pathways I created with the sand. Especially the new Plants from the recently released Tropica Special Edition, Rotala Vietnam and Blyxa Japonica really gave this tank a good balance and added necessary impact. I reached a great 6th ranked in the EAPLC Nano Category with this scape wich is my best rank in the bigger competitions so far."
said Fabian Beck
descriptions_cn: 这个水族箱和造景分两阶段完成。第一阶段是“只有水草和石头”的构图。我在为欧洲“WebAquascapingContest”拍摄第一张照片后，改变了水族箱，移出了部分水草，并加入了化妆砂。我还用碎石构建细节，并在用砂创造的路径周围添加了一些物种。特别是新引入的Tropica Special Edition中的Rotala Vietnam和日本箦藻，为这个水族箱带来了很好的平衡，并增加了必要的冲击力。我凭借这个造景在EAPLC Nano类别中获得了第6名，这是我迄今为止在大型比赛中取得的最佳排名。
Fabian Beck 说

detail_list.name: Layout 125 - Tropica Beach
descriptions: "I had the vision of 2 strong branches being surrounded by moss and plants on a shore line. With some additions of different Anubias species I got from friends this scape got more details in the midground than I have expected but I really like it. I wanted to achieve the Nymphaea Lotus in the center back to grow to the water surface, but it somehow felt more comfortable on the bottom of the aquarium."
said Fabian Beck
descriptions_cn: 我设想在岸边有两根强壮的枝条被莫丝和植物环绕。加上一些朋友赠送的不同袖珍小榕属植物后，中景比预期的更有细节，我非常喜欢。我原本希望虎斑睡莲能在后方中心生长到水面，但感觉它更适合留在水族箱底部。
Fabian Beck 说

detail_list.name: Layout 124 - Ndokulandela
descriptions: "Ndokulandela has it's name from a song from Bongeziwe Mabandla, a great musician. Ndokulandela means to stay on the road you want to go, no matter what. This scape has only african Plants, Anubias and Bolbitis. I used the taller leaves on the front bottom of the aquarium and arranged the smaller sized anubias 'petite' on the higher spots to create a better illusion of scale in this scape. In the beginning I wanted to only keep african fish aswell and started with Aplocheilichthys normani, an Westafrican Fish that is very agile. But after a couple of weeks I had to find a home for other fish I kept, so I started mixing it up a bit and added Microgeophagus Ramirezi Electric Blue and Corydoras Hastatus after a while. The whole layout is made by a few Black Seiryu stones and 5 pieces of Yati Wood that are glued with super glue. I added some Spiderwood under the Yati wood to provide a bit more of a jungle look with roots crawling down the massive central tree. I am quite happy with the result of this tank but had to shut it down due to a massive Cladophora (Algae) Invasion that was very hard to treat."
said Fabian Beck
descriptions_cn: Ndokulandela 这个造景的名字来源于邦格兹威·马班达的一首歌，他是一位伟大的音乐家。Ndokulandela 的意思是坚持你想要走的路，无论遇到什么。这个造景只使用了非洲植物，包括水榕和黑木蕨。我在前部底部使用了高大的叶片，而在较高位置布置了迷你水榕，以营造更好的比例感。起初，我只想养非洲鱼，开始时养了西非的敏捷鱼 Aplocheilichthys normani。但几周后，我不得不为其他鱼寻找栖身之地，于是开始混合搭配，后来添加了电蓝丽鱼 Microgeophagus Ramirezi 和黑点刺脂鲤 Corydoras Hastatus。整个构图由几块深色青龙石和五块 Yati 木头构成，木头用超强力胶固定。我还添加了一些蜘蛛木在 Yati 木下方，以增加丛林的感觉，根系沿着中央大树垂下。我对这个鱼缸的结果感到满意，但由于 Cladophora（绿藻）的严重入侵，我不得不关闭鱼缸进行治疗。
Fabian Beck 说

detail_list.name: Layout 123 - Gloomy forrest
descriptions: "This was my first serious approach for IAPLC contest in 2020 and I had the goal to rank arround 350. Finally I achieved a 365 place. The tank was hard to maintain since I created to close to the front and had nearly any place for maintenance or plant growth. I worked several times on the layout which can be seen in the images of different stages of the tank. I also added lots of different plant species after initial setup."
said Fabian Beck
descriptions_cn: 这是我第一次认真准备参加 2020 年的 IAPLC 比赛，当时给自己定的目标是进入 350 名左右，最后获得了第 365 名。这个缸维护起来很困难，因为造景离前玻璃太近，几乎没有留下维护和水草生长的空间。我前后调整过几次构图，从不同阶段的照片里可以看出变化。开缸后，我还陆续增加了不少水草品种。

detail_list.name: Layout 121 - Low Roar

technique.substrate: ADA Amazonia Soil 9l. ADA power sand advanced 2l

descriptions: For this layout, the title "Low Roar" was chosen to represent the dormant nature of underwater life and its forces. While tranquil at first sight, the layout intends to express a sense of ´danger´ and awe to the viewer, like a tiger out of sight in the dark jungle ready to jump at its prey at any moment.

Inspirations came from both a more classic approach to a nature aquarium style of layout, while having a stronger emphasis on detailed use of tiny roots often seen in more dioramic style. I wouldn´t personally call it a fusion, but more of personal take on a classic approach.

Creating the layout, lots of stone were placed before fixating larger pieces of wood in a natural ´sweeping´ motion going both down and up, creating an concave design to the layout. initially filter wat were pushed between gaps in the stone to help separate soil and cosmetic sand. Pieces of stone also had to be placed on top of the larger pieces of wood to avoid buoyancy in the beginning. Super glue was used to attach small pieces of roots to add detail, and a sense of 'age' along with aquatic mosses and ferns.
In the back, stems were placed in a purposefully chaotic order to show off color and create layers of wildness of beautiful aquatic plants.

The amount of plants used in this layout meant that trimming and maintenance had to be done on regular basis to avoid water flow to stagnate. To help slow down plant growth I used a very lean dosage of plant fertilizer, using only 2ml of Tropica Specialized a day for this 180L aquarium - this is evidently possible when used in conjunction with a nutrient rich substrate.
Overall I think the layout turned out very well. I was especially pleased with the balance between plants and layout material that ended up complimenting each other beautifully in my opinion.
The layout ranked 14th. place in medium category at 2020 EAPLC competition.

technique_cn.substrate: ADA Amazonia Soil 9l. ADA power sand advanced 2l
technique_cn.fertiliser_weekly: 每天添加2ml Tropica Specialised Nutrition。

descriptions_cn: 这个造景的主题名为“低吼”，意在表现水下生命的沉寂状态及其潜在的力量。乍看之下宁静，但造景旨在给观者一种“危险”和敬畏的感觉，就像黑暗丛林中潜伏的老虎，随时准备扑向猎物。
灵感来源于一种更经典的自然水族造景构图，同时更加注重细腻地使用细根，这种细节在更具场景感的造景中常见。这并不是一种融合，而是一种个人对经典方法的诠释。
搭建骨架时，先摆入大量石材，再固定较大的木材，让其以自然舒展的走势分别向上、向下延伸，形成内凹式构图。起初在石缝中塞入过滤棉，将水草泥与化妆砂隔开；较大的木材上方还需要压石，防止初期浮起。最后用瞬间胶粘接细小根枝，配合水生莫丝和蕨类，补充细节并营造出一定的岁月感。
在后景，有茎草被刻意布置成一种混乱的秩序，以展示色彩并营造出美丽水生植物层次繁多的野生效果。
为了防止水流停滞，这个造景使用了大量的水草，因此需要定期修剪和维护。为了减缓水草生长，我使用了极少量的水草肥料，每天仅使用2ml的Tropica Specialized，这在配合富含养分的底床上是可行的，特别是这个180L的水族箱。
整体来看，造景效果非常好。我个人特别满意植物与造景材料之间的平衡，它们在我的感觉中完美地相互衬托。
这个造景在2020年EAPLC比赛中中型造景类排名第14名。

detail_list.name: Layout 120 - Green River

technique.fertiliser_weekly: ADA, neutral K, mineral, iron, 3 x Pumps/day

descriptions: My inspiration for this layout was a small creek from tropical forest. The Challenge was to find the right hardscape. The size and shape needed to be perfect to fit this shallow aquarium.

I build the hardscape to mimic the flow from left to right, so you can see the movement of the water. As part of the maintenance routine I have performed a 50% wc every week and dosed liquid fertilizer on daily basis.

In this layout I have primary used reverse osmosis water and aimed for very low tds - this is good to keep the algae away, but also has had negative effect on growth of Rotala species. It is important to find the right balance between RO water and tap water for the the correct amount of minerals.

technique_cn.decoration: 青龙石 8 kg，Waitomo 沉木 6 根

descriptions_cn: 我的灵感来自热带森林中的小溪。挑战在于找到合适的骨架，大小和形状必须完美匹配这个浅水缸。
我构建了骨架来模拟从左到右的水流，让你能感受到水的流动。作为维护的一部分，我每周进行一次50%的换水，并每天施用液肥。
在这个造景中，我主要使用了反渗透水，目标是将 TDS 控制在很低的水平，这样可以有效抑制藻类生长，但同时也对罗拉属植物的生长产生了负面影响。找到反渗透水和自来水之间合适的矿物质含量平衡非常重要。

technique_cn.decoration: 沉木 3 块， frodo 石 3 千克，暗色指形木

technique.light: 1 x LED 36W + 2 x Easy LED 52W + 1 x LED 18W

descriptions: On the Rocks

Among the many current trends in aquascaping is the hardscape dominated layout, in short this is an aquascape where the overall shape is provided almost entirely by rockwork and sometimes wood. Planting is usually sparse in these setups and takes the form of highlights in areas that the prominent hardscape allows. This style of layout has given rise to much debate on social media as in recent years they have frequently appeared in the top 100 places of the International Plant Layout Contest. In the context of this competition, I can see why many people are reluctant to accept them given that it is a plant layout contest rather than a rock layout contest. However, within the arena of general aquaria I think this type of aquascape is as legitimate as any other style of layout. I have, after all, seen some truly stunning Tanganyika and Malawi Cichlid setups that consist of just intricately placed rockwork. As I am a fan of rock-based aquascapes I decided to try and set up a low energy hardscape orientated layout with minimal planting.
Challenges

There are, of course, challenges with any aquarium but with this one there was the glaringly obvious issue of a very low plant mass. The usual advice to anyone setting up a planted tank would be to plant heavily from the outset, particularly when not using CO2. In a densely planted tank nutrient uptake will be higher and the plants stand a good chance of out competing algae. To combat algae in a sparsely planted tank stock an efficient cleaning crew and be meticulous with maintenance.

Another cause for concern was the amount of exposed rockwork. Even aquariums that are full of healthy plants will suffer from slime algae on rockwork that receives light. It is unlikely that any cleaning crew will be efficient enough to deal with this and the rocks will have to be scrubbed regularly with a toothbrush. This can be very time consuming but worse than that it can cause a collapse of the carefully arranged hardscape. The smaller the tank the more likely a collapse will be as the rocks be lighter in weight and less resistant to brushing without moving. Placing rocks so that their shapes lock together will help prevent movement, alternatively sticking them to each other with epoxy putty will make them very secure. However, the putty is hard to remove and looks unsightly so it may render the rocks unusable for future aquascapes.
The Layout

For this aquascape I wanted to try something different, I had previously acquired a large box of what is commonly sold as Pagoda Stone and this seemed like the ideal opportunity to use it. This rock has an interesting surface texture and consists of vivid orange layers interspersed with softer layers of beige. The deep grooves of the strata combined with the colour contrast seem to make the stones appear much larger than they are, which is perfect for creating a sense of scale. The rocks reminded me of the Grand Canyon so I thought that a canyon style layout would look most natural. When arranging hardscapes of this complexity I find it best to do a dry run outside of the tank, that way I can tweak at my leisure until I am satisfied I have found the best arrangement. I made a model of the tank from an old cardboard box and filled the base with gravel to carry out my practise runs, see pictures below.
Planting

As the planting would be sparse, I tried to add interest by using numerous species. The finer textured plants were to some extent used at the back of the tank and the broader leaved varieties used towards the front. Tropica Taxiphyllum ‘spikey’ was tied to some small pieces of lava rock and placed where I felt it would creep naturally across the stones in the upper portion of the scape. Next, I added some Tropica Eleocharis parvula which was planted in a rather unusual manner. I had no substrate where I wanted to place the Eleocharis and I did not think it would grow well tied to lava rock. Instead, I wrapped the roots in small portions of filter wool and pushed them in between the gaps in the stones until only the plant was visible. I considered leaving some of the mineral wool attached and pushing that between the rocks, but it disintegrates easily and I thought the shrimps might pull it apart. I also used this filter wool method to plant some Tropica Pogostemon helferi and Tropica Staurogyne repens amongst the stones. Without their roots in the substrate, I was afraid they might lack sustenance so I dosed 8ml of Tropica premium liquid fertiliser every day to compensate. At the front of the tank, I planted conventionally into the substrate with Cryptocoryne albida ‘brown’, Pogostemon helferi and Staurogyne repens. Some Anubias ‘petite was tied to lava rocks and used to fill the gaps on the far right and left of the tank.
Stocking and maintenance

In order to keep algae to a minimum the tank was initially stocked with 5 Amano shrimps (Caridina multidentata) and 4 dwarf suckermouth catfish (Ottocinclus affinis). Also instrumental in keeping algae at bay was the ability to adjust the intensity of the light. This is particularly important in tanks without CO2 injection as you can’t simply increase the CO2 levels to match the lights. The dimmer on the Aquabar ‘T’ series LED lighting was sensitive enough to allow for accurate control. After the scape had been up and running for about 6 weeks and I was sure the plants were growing well I added 12 small neon tetras (Paracheirodon innesi).

The maintenance schedule was more grueling than it has been with my other low energy setups. That said I still feel that it was less work than is needed for a high energy system. I carried out one 60% water change each week at which point I also changed the filter wool, cleaned the tank glass and pruned the plants. This style of layout required the plants to be kept small and not obscure the hardscape so pruning was more regular despite the slow growth rates. The most time consuming aspect was, as I had anticipated, cleaning the rocks. They very quickly became covered in green slime algae and needed to be scrubbed with a toothbrush every week just before the water change. It took roughly 30 minutes to complete the task and on a couple of occasions, I wished I had stuck the rocks together. However, I did not cause a total collapse during the layout’s 16-week lifespan and I feel that the aesthetic of the aquascape benefitted from having clean rocks. Whilst this setup might not be for everyone, given that a weekly maintenance session took 60 minutes, it is still achievable for beginners and I think it has a different and eye catching look.

descriptions_cn: 在石头上

目前水草造景的趋势之一是骨架主导的构图。简而言之，这种构图的整体形状几乎完全由岩石构成，有时也会加入一些木材。在这种设置中，植物种植通常较为稀疏，仅作为骨架突出区域的点缀。这种风格的构图在社交媒体上引发了大量讨论，因为在近年来的国际植物布局竞赛中，它们经常出现在前100名的位置。在竞赛背景下，许多人不愿接受这种构图，因为这是植物布局竞赛，而不是岩石布局竞赛。然而，在一般水族箱中，我认为这种构图与其他任何风格一样正当。毕竟，我见过一些令人惊叹的坦桑尼亚和马拉维慈鲷鱼缸，它们仅由精心布置的岩石构成。作为岩石基构图的爱好者，我决定尝试设置一个低能耗的骨架主导布局，植物种植量极少。
挑战
当然，任何水族箱都有挑战，但在这个造景中，最明显的问题是植物量非常少。通常建议新手设置水草造景时，应从一开始就大量种植，尤其是在不使用 CO₂ 的情况下。在密集种植的造景中，养分吸收量更高，植物有很好的机会与藻类竞争。在稀疏种植的造景中，应饲养高效的清洁生物，并仔细进行维护。

另一个令人担忧的问题是裸露在外的岩石。即使水族箱中植物健康茂盛，也会在受光的岩石上滋生黏泥藻。清洁工可能无法高效处理这个问题，因此需要定期用牙刷清洁岩石，这非常耗时，而且可能会导致精心布置的骨架结构崩溃。小水族箱更容易发生这种情况，因为岩石较轻，刷洗时容易移动。将岩石形状错开放置，可以减少移动，或者使用环氧树脂泥固定岩石，可以使它们更加稳固。然而，环氧树脂泥难以去除且外观不佳，可能会使岩石在未来造景中无法使用。
造景构图

这是我想要尝试不同的水草造景。之前我买了一大盒通常被称为宝塔石的石头，这似乎是个使用它的绝佳机会。这种石头表面纹理独特，橙色层与米黄色层交错，深邃的层理沟壑与色彩对比使石头看起来比实际更大，非常适合营造空间感。这些石头让我想起了大峡谷，所以我决定采用峡谷风格的构图。在布置这种复杂的骨架时，我发现最好先在缸外做一次干式预演，这样可以随意调整，直到满意为止。我用一个旧纸箱制作了水族箱模型，并在底部铺上砂粒进行练习，如下图所示。
种植

由于种植较为稀疏，我尝试通过多种植物种类来增加趣味性。细叶植物主要用于造景的后部，而宽叶植物则放置在前部。我将Tropica尖叶莫丝绑在一些小块玄武岩上，并放置在造景的上部，使其自然地蔓延在石头上。接着，我添加了一些Tropica迷你牛毛毡，但没有底床可以种植，我认为绑在玄武岩上也不合适。因此，我用过滤棉包裹住根部，并将植物塞进石头之间的缝隙中，只露出植物部分。我考虑过让过滤棉附着在石头上，但过滤棉容易分解，担心虾会将其扯开。我也用同样的方法种植了一些Tropica喷泉太阳和Tropica矮生叉柱花在石头之间。由于它们的根部没有在底床上，我每天施用了8ml的Tropica高级液肥来补充养分。在造景的前部，我将棕色阿尔比达椒草、喷泉太阳和矮生叉柱花常规种植在底床上。我还用一些迷你水榕绑在玄武岩上，填充了造景右侧和左侧的空隙。
生物配置与维护

为尽量控制藻类，开缸初期放入了 5 只大和沼虾（Caridina multidentata）和 4 条小精灵（Ottocinclus affinis）。可调节灯光强度同样有助于抑制藻类；对不添加 CO₂ 的缸来说尤其重要，因为无法简单提高 CO₂ 浓度来匹配更强的光照。Aquabar ‘T’ 系列 LED 灯的调光器足够灵敏，可以精确控制亮度。造景运行约 6 周、确认水草生长良好后，又加入了12 条红绿灯（Paracheirodon innesi）。

我的维护计划比其他低能耗造景更费力，但仍然觉得比高能耗系统所需的维护工作要少。每周我进行一次60%的换水，同时更换滤材、清洁鱼缸玻璃和修剪植物。这种风格的造景需要保持植物较小，不遮挡骨架，因此尽管生长缓慢，修剪也更频繁。最耗时的部分正如我所预料的，是清洁石头。石头很快被绿色黏泥藻覆盖，每周换水前需要用牙刷清洁一次，大约需要30分钟。在几次清洁过程中，我甚至希望将石头粘在一起。不过，在造景16周的生命周期内，我没有造成整体崩溃，而且我认为清洁的石头提升了造景的美观度。虽然这种设置可能不是每个人的选择，因为每周的维护需要60分钟，但初学者仍然可以实现，我认为它有独特的吸引眼球的外观。

descriptions: Dutch Tank by the rule... here's what Pedro considered making his own Dutch challenge:
Why? Because I love this kind of tank! Because having to comply to certain rules gives be some challenges that aquascaping doesn’t have…

I want to continue to learn good trimming techniques regarding large bunch of stem plants and many different species at the same tank. Plants have different growth rates and having a tank with so much different plants, should be a challenge having it looking nice and balanced most of the time. … and a Dutch Tank is really about the growth and arrangement of aquatic plants!!! Over the last months I read some stuff about Dutch Tanks. Since the end of August (2015) I read some of those sources again.
So, what do I want? I want a tank with a good first impression, great plant contrast and a nice perspective and depth of field, knowing that this can only be achieved with… plants!

From my readings and talks with someone used to this type of aquariums, I made a small rule list: - Traditional focal points / rule of thirds. Red plants should be placed accordingly. - No two plants of the same color (similar colors shouldn’t also be placed next to each other). - No two plants with the same leaf shape should be placed next to each other. - Plants should be placed in “streets”, wider at the front, narrow at the back, hiding away behind other plant preferably. This way a better depth is achieved. - Plants can’t be repeated. - Aim for good contrast but also simplicity.
It’s obvious that a great number of plants are needed for making a Dutch on 120cm. Controlling all those plants is a must - or there is a chaos waiting for me!
I found that following the leaf shape rule is much easier than the color rule!

Then we have the height of the plants that should also be different for plants next to each other. And finally, we have fore/middle and background plants… and having these possible three rows knowing that plants should be placed forming “streets” of plants that will get smaller to the back of the tank... I think you see the difficulty in planning a Dutch tank.
After 3 months some larger leafs plants were clearly needed, so I chose Nymphaea Lotus and Hygophila simanesis 53B.

descriptions_cn: 这是按照荷兰造景规则打造的水草造景作品。佩德罗认为这是他自己的荷兰造景挑战：
为什么？因为我喜欢这种缸！遵循特定规则，也会带来普通水草造景里没有的挑战……
我想继续学习如何修剪大型有茎草群和多种不同种类的植物。植物的生长速度各不相同，所以在一个包含多种植物的缸里保持它们的美观和平衡是一项挑战。……而荷兰缸真的就是关于水草的生长和布局！！！过去几个月我阅读了一些关于荷兰缸的文章。自2015年8月底以来，我重新阅读了一些这些资料。
我想拥有的是一个给人良好第一印象的鱼缸，植物对比鲜明，有良好的视角和深度，我知道这一切都只能通过植物来实现！
根据我的阅读和与熟悉这类水族造景的人交谈，我总结了一些小规则： - 传统焦点/三分法。红色植物应按此布局。 - 不要将同色系的植物放在一起（相似叶形的植物也不行）。 - 不要将叶形相同的植物放在一起。 - 植物应按“街道”布局，前方宽后方窄，最好隐藏在其他植物之后，以增加深度。 - 植物不能重复。 - 追求对比但也要简洁。
很明显，要在120厘米的缸里造一个荷兰式水草造景需要大量的植物。必须控制好这些植物，不然等着我的就是一团糟了。！
我发现遵循叶片形状规则要比遵循颜色规则容易得多！
然后是植物的高度，相邻的植物高度也应不同。最后是前景、中景和后景植物……考虑到植物应排列成“街道”，这些街道从缸前到缸后逐渐变小……我认为你已经体会到规划荷兰造景缸的难度了。
三个月后，明显需要一些大叶植物，所以我选择了虎斑睡莲和泰国水蓑衣53B。

detail_list.name: Layout 104
descriptions: This aquascape is based on the idea of a fallen branch. Mosses were used exclusively in this setup to create a textural appearance in keeping with the very small size of the fish. The Moss was attached to lava rock with hair nets tied off with fishing line, I find this method to be quickest.
It was also necessary to stock heavily with shrimps to keep the Moss in good health.

technique_cn.fertiliser_weekly: Tropica Specialised 和 Premium 液肥

descriptions_cn: 这个造景的构思来自一根倒下的树枝。全景只使用莫丝，以细腻的质感呼应缸内体形很小的鱼。莫丝先铺在火山石上，再罩上发网并用钓鱼线扎紧；我觉得这是最快的固定方法。
还需要投放大量的虾来保持莫丝的健康。

detail_list.name: Layout 103
descriptions: Although not strictly a biotope aquarium all of the Flora and Fauna in this setup are from Australasia, with the exception of the shrimp which were used to keep the tank free from algae.
The layout is simple, using just one piece of wood and only three species of plants. Planting and maintenance was easy to carry out, with weekly pruning and water change taking just over 30 minutes.
descriptions_cn: 虽然这不是一个严格的生物栖息地水族造景，但造景中的所有水草和生物都来自澳大利亚地区，除了用于控制藻类的虾。
造景构图很简单，仅使用了一块木头和三种植物。种植和维护非常容易，每周修剪和换水只需超过30分钟。

detail_list.name: Layout 102
descriptions: A classic nano "Nature Aquarium" layout based around one piece of driftwood and small pieces of mini landscape rock. Most plants used are 1-2-Grow, which are perfect for aquascaping a small aquarium. The fine textures of the plants enhance the sense of scale. The relatively large selection of species help to create a naturalistic and wild feel to the layout.

Floating Salvinia natans provides shade to prevent algae and slows the growth of otherwise fast growing stem plants. Splashes of red from the Alternanthera and Palustris add interest and the small Eleocharis 'mini' provides the perfect foreground.

Maintenance First week - 50% water change every day. Second week - 50% water change 3 times per week. Third week - 50% water change 2 times per week. After one month - 25% water change 2 times per week. 1 pump of Tropica Specialised per day. Filter cleaned every 2 weeks. Plants pruned every 2 weeks, as necessary.
descriptions_cn: 这是一套经典的纳米自然水族造景，以一块沉木和几块迷你景观石为主体。大部分水草来自 1-2-Grow! 系列，很适合小型水草缸。细腻的叶片质感强化了比例感，较丰富的物种搭配则让构图呈现出自然、略带野趣的气质。
小槐叶萍提供了遮荫，防止藻类生长，并减缓其他快速生长的有茎草的生长速度。迷你血心兰和古巴锯齿草的红色点缀增加了趣味性，而迷你牛毛毡则完美地构成了前景。
第一周 - 每天换水50%。第二周 - 每周换水50%三次。第三周 - 每周换水50%两次。一个月后 - 每周换水25%两次。每天按一下 Tropica Specialised 肥料泵头。滤材每两周清洁一次。植物每两周修剪一次，视情况而定。

detail_list.name: Layout 100
descriptions: The classic "three sisters" are surrounded by the plants Limnophila Hippuridoides, Penthorum Sedoides, Eleocharis Parvula and Rotala 'Bonsai'. Penthorum has to be trimmed massively and frequently, in order to create many compact side shoots with smaller and compact leaves. The uneven and wild prairie layout is created by using regularly trimmed Eleocharis Parvula in the front.
Note: Plant B on the drawing is Penthorum Sedoides which is no longer produced by Tropica. Can be replaced with Staurogyne repens or another stem plant.
descriptions_cn: 经典的“三姐妹”被红宝塔、penthorum sedoides、迷你牛毛毡和印度小圆叶环绕。penthorum sedoides 需要频繁且大量修剪，以形成许多紧凑的小侧枝和小叶。通过在前景使用定期修剪过的迷你牛毛毡，造就了一片不规则而野生的草原造景。
注意：图纸中的Plant B是Penthorum sedoides，Tropica已不再生产。可以替换为矮生叉柱花或另一种有茎草。

detail_list.name: Layout 99
descriptions: The Asian inspired landscape is a brilliant addition for the bamboo-like Murdannia Keisak. Murdannia is very fast-growing and requires frequent and comprehensive cutting. New shoots and replanted top shoots maintain the three groups. Eleocharis Parvula in the back is floatingly revealed by the lower Eleocharis 'Mini' and incorporated in the front scenery.
descriptions_cn: 亚洲风格的景观是水竹叶的理想搭配。水竹叶生长迅速，需要频繁且全面地修剪。新芽和重新种植的顶部芽保持了三个区域。后景的迷你牛毛毡通过底部的迷你牛毛毡浮动展现，并融入前景景观中。

detail_list.name: Layout 98
descriptions: Aqua Decor products and a close wall of Spiky moss initially made this aquarium vigorous and easy to balance. Nymphoides and Pogostemon Erectus are the only fast-growing plants that require regular trimming. Lagenandra will over time get bigger leaves that may be too shadowy; they are easily removed. The moss wall is carefully lifted out and trimmed with scissors when required.
descriptions_cn: Aqua Decor 产品配合浓密的松茸莫丝墙，让水草缸在初期就显得繁茂，也更容易建立平衡。台湾水莲和直立百叶是其中仅有的两种速生草，需要定期修剪。美波莉椒草的叶片会逐渐变大，可能造成过度遮阴，这些大叶可以轻松摘除；莫丝墙需要修剪时，则小心取出后用剪刀处理。

detail_list.name: Layout 97
descriptions: An orange-red abundance of Rotala Macrandra frames the central roots along with vivid light green Cuba-Hemianthus. Thin transparent straws of the high Eleocharis sp. make the layout look deep and full of perspective. Hydrocotyle and Nymphoides are both fast-growing and they require regular trimming. The low, compact growth of Bacopa 'Compact' is a result of continuous cutting and replanting of top shoots.
Plant D on the drawing is Penthorum sedoides, which is no longer produced by Tropica.
descriptions_cn: 红蝴蝶草呈现橙红色的繁茂景象，围绕着中央的根系，与鲜艳的迷你矮珍珠-珍珠草相映成趣。高长牛毛草纤细透明的叶片让造景显得深邃而富有层次感。三裂天胡荽和台湾水莲都生长迅速，需要定期修剪。迷你小对叶的低矮生长是由于连续剪取顶部枝条并重新种植所致。
画中的Plant D是Penthorum sedoides，Tropica已不再生产这种植物。

detail_list.name: Layout 96
descriptions: Fifteen different plants create a wealth of vigorous details around the two islands. The strong pink colour of Alternanthera 'Rosanervig' is beautifully reflected in Limnophila Hippuridoides above it. Massive and regular cutting is essential, in order to maintain the expression and making sure that all plant groups grow vigorously.
descriptions_cn: 15 种水草围绕两座小岛生长，构成丰富而繁茂的细节。豹纹血心兰鲜明的粉红色，与其上方的红宝塔相互呼应。要维持这样的观感，并让各组水草都能旺盛生长，必须经常进行大幅修剪。

detail_list.name: Layout 95

technique.decoration: Lava rock, Mangrove wood, Sumatra driftwood

descriptions: Ferns and mosses fight about the space around the tree roots, while Eleocharis and Cryptocorynes do the same underneath them and Ludwigia and Vallisneria behind them. The wild and untamed expression is carefully planned. The layout requires regular trimming and cutting, in order to prevent the fast-growing plants from overshadowing and suffocating the slow-growing plants – as it happens in nature.

technique_cn.decoration: 熔岩岩、红树林木、苏门答腊沉木

descriptions_cn: 蕨类和莫丝在树木根部周围争夺空间，迷你牛毛毡和椒草则在它们下方竞争，超红水丁香和苦草则在它们后面生长。这种野生而未加约束的生长状态是经过精心规划的。造景布局需要定期修剪和修剪，以防止快速生长的植物遮盖和挤压慢生长的植物——就像自然界一样。

detail_list.name: Layout 94
descriptions: Eight different 1-2-Grow! plants were planted in Aquarium Soil Powder around two groups of grey-black lava rocks. Abundant low and creeping plants create long, horizontal lines that make the aquarium seem peaceful and calm. The stem plants require regular trimming, in order to stay low and compact.
descriptions_cn: 在两组灰黑色玄武岩周围种植了八种1-2-Grow! 水草，使用了水草泥粉作为底床。茂盛的低矮匍匐植物形成长长的水平线条，使水族箱显得宁静平和。有茎草需要定期修剪，以保持低矮紧凑的状态。

detail_list.name: Layout 93
descriptions: The light distribution is extremely centred in this oblong aquarium, which results in quite shady corners.
Alternanthera 'Mini' is placed in the middle, in order to achieve optimal colour under the best light.
Light green Pogostemon erectus and Hygrophila 'Rosanervig' with pink streaks grow behind the mangrove root. In front, Eleocharis 'Mini' and Staurogyne create tight, low areas of vegetation.
All plants are from the 1-2-Grow! Series, except for Hygrophila 'Rosanervig'.
descriptions_cn: 这个长形水族箱的光照分布非常集中，导致角落部分比较阴暗。
迷你血心兰放置在中间，以便在最佳光照下实现最优色彩。
浅绿色的直立百叶和带有粉红色条纹的红丝青叶生长在红树根的后面。前面，迷你牛毛毡和矮生叉柱花营造出紧密的低矮植被区域。
所有植物来自1-2- Grow! 系列，除了红丝青叶。

detail_list.name: Layout 92
descriptions: A small and well-functioning aquarium!
This aquarium does not have an awful lot of light, but the quadratic layout ensures uniform light distribution.
A diagonal mangrove root creates coherence, depth and fine growing conditions for Anubias 'Petite'.
The fertile bottom layer of Lilaeopsis brasiliensis does not require much light and only limited care. The stem plants Hottonia and Rotala grow faster and require regular cutting.
descriptions_cn: 一个小型而功能完善的水草造景！
这个水族箱的光照不算很强，但方形造景确保了均匀的光照分布。
一条对角线上的红树林根创造了连贯性，深度，并为迷你水榕提供了良好的生长条件。
南美尖叶草皮的底床肥沃，不需要太多光线，只需少量护理。帕鹿雪花草和红宫廷的有茎草生长较快，需要定期修剪。

detail_list.name: Layout 91
descriptions: For most people, the interest for aquariums as a hobby begins with a starter set. Unfortunately, it often ends here, if the set doesn't work properly!
The amount of light of 0.2 Watt/Litre limits the selection of plants; however, it is possible. Read more the various needs of aquarium plants here.
Microsorum, Anubias and Cryptocorynes are some of the most low-light plants and they are very suitable for this aquarium. Due to their slow growth, they only require minimum care.
Hygrophila polysperma is also suitable, if it is allowed to grow all the way to the water surface, and is carefully cut back.
Echinodorus bleheri grows slowly but in a reliable manner and has to be cut, in order not to shade other plants.
descriptions_cn: 对于大多数人来说，水族箱作为爱好始于一套入门套装。可惜的是，如果这套套装不能正常工作，他们的兴趣往往就到此为止了！
光照强度为0.2瓦/升限制了可选植物的种类，但还是有可能的。了解更多水草的需求详情请点击。
铁皇冠、小水榕和椒草是光照需求较低的植物，非常适合这个水族箱。由于它们生长缓慢，只需要 minimal 的护理。
青叶草也可以种植，如果让它生长到水面，并且定期修剪。
亚马逊皇冠草生长缓慢但稳定，需要定期修剪，以免遮挡其他植物。

detail_list.name: Layout 90
descriptions: The starter set is often used for getting acquainted with aquariums as a hobby. Thus, it must be a success.

The amount of light of 0.3 Watt/Litre water is not much in terms of plant requirements, but several plant varieties are suitable if you are careful with your plant selection. (Read more the various needs of aquarium plants here.)
The growth rate is moderate, which ensures minimal plant care and time to correct possible faults.
The low-light Anubias and Cryptocorynes are placed on sides with a minimum of light. Java moss (Taxiphyllum barbieri) is also suitable for this position.
Both Limnophila sessiliflora and Limnophila hippuridoides thrive in the centre under the light, where they add shades of fresh green and red violet.
descriptions_cn: 入门套装常用于初学者熟悉养鱼缸这项爱好，因此必须成功。
水下光照强度为 0.3 瓦/升并不高，但如果你谨慎选择水草种类，仍适合多种植物生长。（了解更多水族植物的需求请点击此处。）
生长速度适中，确保了最少的植物护理工作和纠正可能问题所需的时间。
小水榕和椒草放置在光照最少的侧面。爪哇莫丝（爪哇莫丝 爪哇莫丝）也适合这个位置。
小宝塔和红宝塔在灯光下中心位置生长得非常好，为造景增添了鲜绿和紫红的色彩。

detail_list.name: Layout 89
descriptions: An aquarium with robust and reliable plants that is easy to tend and maintain.

By means of the fast-growing Vallisneria, Hygrophila, Ludwigia and Echinodorus, the aquarium quickly gains a mass of plants that makes it stable. The low-light plants Anubias and Monosolenium are placed under Vallisneria and Echinodorus, while a ground cover of Lilaeopsis brasiliensis and Hydrocotyle tripartite gain light in front. Red Alternanthera 'Rosanervig' and Ludwigia sp. are used as focus plants.
descriptions_cn: 这是一个植物健壮可靠、易于养护和维护的水草造景缸。
苦草、水蓑衣、水丁香和皇冠草生长较快，能迅速增加缸内草量，帮助系统稳定。耐阴的水榕和珊瑚莫丝种在苦草与皇冠草下方，前景的南美草皮和三裂天胡荽则能获得更多光照。豹纹血心兰与红色水丁香作为视觉焦点。

detail_list.name: Layout 88
descriptions: The children's aquarium should be fun and easy. All children know Nemo, surrounded by sea anemones and jellyfish.

Nemo hides in two Anubias nana that are carefully attached on both sides of the figure. Cabomba caroliniana and Egeria densa are the easiest stem plants for the aquarium. Split the bundle into separate stems and plant them on the bottom layer. The stem grows steadily and is cut off 5-10cm over the bottom, when touching the surface. The cut off stem can be planted on the bottom layer to repeat the process.
descriptions_cn: 儿童水族箱应该既有趣又容易打理。所有的孩子都知道尼莫，它被海葵和水母环绕。
小丑鱼藏在两侧精心固定的小水榕中。绿菊和水蕴草是水族箱中最容易种植的有茎草。将植株分成单枝，然后种植在底床上。茎会稳定生长，当茎长到距离底部5-10厘米并触碰到水面时，剪掉这部分茎，剪下的茎可以再次种植在底床上，重复这个过程。

detail_list.name: Layout 87

technique.fertiliser_weekly: Premium Fertiliser; ADA Green Gain; ADA Phyton Git

descriptions: James: I have found it possible to get no algae at all in tanks as small as 3 litres with no filter, no CO2 and no algae eaters.
The tank in the photo was 10 weeks old. It was initially planted with plants that were already growing submerged, which I think helped.

However, the most important thing, in my opinion, is to change 100% of the water every day just before you switch the lights on. All tanks where I have done this seem to be completely algae free after week 4.
Perhaps the combination of stable water conditions, water that is rich in CO2 and O2 and a little chlorine are bad for algae!

technique_cn.fertiliser_weekly: Premium Fertiliser；ADA Green Gain；ADA Phyton Git

descriptions_cn: 詹姆斯发现，即使在只有3升水、没有过滤器、没有CO₂注入和没有藻类控制鱼的情况下，也能完全避免藻类生长。
这张照片中的鱼缸有10周大。最初种植的是已经水下生长的植物，我认为这很有帮助。
然而，我认为最重要的是在开启灯光前每天更换100%的水。我已经这样做的所有鱼缸在第四周后似乎都完全没有藻类了。
稳定的水质、富含 CO₂ 和氧气以及少量氯可能对藻类不好！

detail_list.name: Layout 86
descriptions: Large pieces of Seiryu Stone were used in the Aquascape to provide a rocky outcrop view in the tank. These were supported upon polystyrene sheets in order not to stress the glass at the base of the tank. Once these rocks were positioned several pieces of Manzanita Wood were used to run through the cracks in the rock to provide a harmonious balance of rock/wood in nature. Various mosses and Hemianthus callitrichoides "Cuba" were used to disguise the edges where the rock met the wood where the wood had been tied to secure it from floating.
Around this, several rocky hill stem plants were used alongside detail plants like hairgrass, crypts and Rotala 'Bonsai' to provide colour and diversity in the aquascape.
Pencilfish were used as a shoal in the tank alongside Red Cherry Barbs and Red Cherry shrimp.
descriptions_cn: 造景中使用了大块青龙石，营造出岩石露头的景观。石材下方垫有泡沫板，避免底部玻璃受力过大。石材就位后，再将几块 Manzanita 木穿插在石缝中，使石材与沉木自然衔接。多种莫丝和迷你矮珍珠被用来遮盖石木交界处，也能隐藏固定沉木、防止其漂浮的绑线。
围绕这些，使用了有茎草和牛毛毡、crypts 和印度小圆叶等细节植物，为造景提供了色彩和多样性。
笔鱼被用作鱼群放在鱼缸中，与红樱桃鱼和红樱桃虾一起。

detail_list.name: Layout 85
descriptions: This aquascape/aquarium was inspired by the classic Dutch themed aquariums. Although it doesn't conform to many of the rules of the Dutch method of aquascaping, it shows how 1-2 grow plants can be used to good effect without using any hardscape. It was interesting to see how the 1-2 grow plants performed in an aquarium without any classic potted species of plants. The different textures and colours of the 1-2 grow plants were very striking as you walked into the room. The fish health and water quality was tremendous due to the high plant mass.

The Aquarium was trimmed about 5-6 times in total, and was very easy to look after. It looked after itself after the initial set up. In the first 2 weeks the water was changed at 40% everyday with pure reverse osmosis water. I used Tropica Specialised and Tropica Premium fertiliser on alternate days. Five pumps of each. It was used in conjunction with aquasoil. After 2 weeks the water change was 20% every 3 days. After 45 days this was dropped to one water change a week. CO2 was used at 1-2 bubbles per second.
Note: Ammania bonsai has since been determined to be Rotala 'bonsai'. Nymphoides 'Taiwan' is now only produced in pot.
descriptions_cn: 这个水草造景受到经典荷兰主题水族箱的启发。虽然它并不遵循荷兰造景方法中的许多规则，但展示了仅使用1-2生长植物而不用骨架植物也能取得很好的效果。令人惊讶的是，在没有传统盆栽植物的情况下，1-2生长植物的表现非常出色。走进房间时，这些植物的不同质感和颜色非常引人注目。由于高密度的植物群，鱼的健康状况和水质都非常好。
这个水族箱总共修剪了5-6次，非常容易养护。设置完成后，它基本能自我维持。前两周每天换40%的水，使用纯反渗透水。我每隔一天使用一次Tropica Specialised和Tropica Premium液肥，每次各5泵。配合使用水草泥。两周后，改为每三天换20%的水。45天后，改为每周换一次水。CO₂的使用量为每秒1-2个气泡。
注意：Ammania 印度小圆叶 已确定为印度小圆叶。台湾水莲 '台湾水莲' 现仅以盆栽形式生产。

detail_list.name: Layout 84
descriptions: The aquarium is inspired by white sandy beaches with few plants spreading from the jungle in the background. The red and well-lighted Nymphaea lotus creates a natural point of focus among several variations of green plants in this aquarium. The front with Staurogyne Repens glides naturally into the plants in the middle, including Microsorum Pteropus 'Trident' and Anubias Barteri var nana 'Petite', resulting in a harmonic connection between the front and middle. The plants in front are sloping a bit from left to right, in order to offer the viewer, who naturally sees this aquarium from the right side of the room, a great perspective. Between the big rocks, Vesicularia ferriei 'Weeping' comes rolling like small waterfalls, tumbling to the sea from inside the dark jungle.
descriptions_cn: 这个水草造景作品灵感来源于白色沙滩和远处丛林中稀疏分布的植物。红色且光照充足的虎斑睡莲成为众多绿色植物中的自然焦点。前景中的矮生叉柱花自然过渡到中景的植物，包括三叉铁皇冠和迷你水榕，形成了前景与中景的和谐连接。前景的植物从左至右略微倾斜，以便观众从房间右侧自然观赏时获得良好的视角。大岩石之间，垂泪莫丝‘垂泪’像小瀑布般流淌，仿佛从黑暗的丛林中倾泻到海中。

detail_list.name: Layout 83
descriptions: This is a tank I basically started to "test" some plants. The starting point was a triangular hardscape, which evolved a lot throughout the tank's life. In the beginning it had a hill dominated by a tree and below this a dead tree hanging over a river. Gradually it transformed into a coloured jungle with a dark entry letting the imagination wander…
descriptions_cn: 这是一个我用来“测试”一些水草的鱼缸。起点是一个三角形的骨架，随着时间的推移，鱼缸的构图发生了很大的变化。最初，这里有一个由树木主导的山丘，山丘下方有一根悬垂的枯木，枯木垂在一条小河上。渐渐地，它变成了一个彩色的丛林，入口处是深色的背景，让人的想象力自由驰骋……

detail_list.name: Layout 82
descriptions: Very large dragon rocks are planted with Hydrocotyle, Anubias and Hygrophila Pinnatifida. On the last, vertical shoots have to be removed, in order to achieve crawling growth. Growth on Hydrocotyle has to be put back into place regularly with a hand, in order to maintain a low and dense appearance.

Ludwigia palustris and Limnophila Hippuridoides create the dense, colourful background and the high Eleocharis species close the edges. The dense Helanthium tenellum 'Green' has to be trimmed quite often, in order to prevent it from taking over the entire bottom.
descriptions_cn: 非常大的龙岩石上种植了三裂天胡荽、袖珍小榕和羽裂水蓑衣。羽裂水蓑衣需要定期去除垂直生长的枝条，以实现匍匐生长。三裂天胡荽的生长也需要定期用手整理，以保持低矮密集的外观。
超红水丁香和红宝塔营造了密集而多彩的背景，长牛毛则封闭了边缘。密集的针叶皇冠草需要经常修剪，以防止其占据整个底床。

detail_list.name: Layout 81
descriptions: This fountain of mangrove wood is the home of Limnophila Sessiliflora, Rotala 'green' and Eleocharis species.

All are plants, which enhance the effect, but require regular trimming. At the base, moss, Anubias and Microsorum, create a passage to the beautiful green plain along with Marsilea Hirsuta and Glossostigma Elatinoides, which Eleocharis 'Mini' has created in only few months. The landscape is comfortable calm and quite easy to maintain.
descriptions_cn: 这棵红树林沉木是小宝塔、绿罗花和迷你牛毛毡的家园。
这些都是植物，能增强效果，但需要定期修剪。在底部，莫丝、水榕和三叉铁皇冠创造了通往美丽绿色草坪的通道，澳洲田字草和矮珍珠也为此贡献良多，迷你牛毛毡仅用了几个月时间就打造了这片草坪。景观舒适宁静，维护也相对容易。

detail_list.name: Layout 80
descriptions: A narrow valley leads through two large tree roots with Microsorum 'Trident'. Behind, Ludwigia palustris and Limnophila Hippuridoides grow and add colour to the mountain pass.

The lawn of the valley includes Eleocharis 'Mini', supplemented with groups of Ammania 'Bonsai', ending in a wide foreground of Micranthemum 'Monte Carlo'. Between the dragon rocks, groups of Echinodorus Tenellus 'green' and massive Cryptocoryne Wendtii 'Tropica are placed'.
descriptions_cn: 一条狭窄的山谷穿过两根大树根，三叉铁皇冠生长其中。山谷后方，超红水丁香和红宝塔草增添了一抹色彩，让山隘更加生动。
谷地的草坪以迷你牛毛毡为主，点缀成丛的印度小圆叶，并向前景延伸为宽阔的趴地珍珠草坪。龙石之间穿插种植绿针叶皇冠和体量较大的特罗皮卡温蒂椒草。

detail_list.name: Layout 79
descriptions: You can almost hear the seagulls call in this fertile, light green beach landscape.

Close vegetation of Myriophyllum Mattogrossense and the high Eleocharis sp., make the background look elegant. Massive cliffs, surrounded by Hottonia, Staurogyne and Microsorum. A wide valley of Cuba-Hemianthus, mixed with Echinodorus Tenellus lead through smaller cliffs to the fine, light sandy shore. Please, go for a swim!
descriptions_cn: 在这片肥沃的淡绿色海滩造景中，几乎能听到海鸥的叫声。
雪花羽毛和长牛毛的密集生长让背景显得优雅。巨大的悬崖周围是帕鹿雪花草、矮生叉柱花和三叉铁皇冠。一条宽谷由迷你矮珍珠-珍珠草和针叶皇冠草铺成，穿过较小的悬崖通向细腻的浅沙岸边。请来游泳吧！

detail_list.name: Layout 78
descriptions: From a massive hill top of black lava stone, redwood branches spread out over smaller pieces of lava.

Various plants are mixed, in order to create interest with their different forms of growth, leaf structure and colours. Marsilea, Eleocharis, Staurogyne, Ranunculus and Rotala 'Bonsai' are mixed at the bottom, while moss, Microsorum and Anubias have to fight with Rotala 'green' and Limnophila Hippuridoides about the space on the hill.
descriptions_cn: 从一块黑色玄武岩的大山顶部，红木枝条延伸覆盖在较小的玄武岩碎片上。
各种植物混搭，以展现它们不同的生长形态、叶片结构和颜色。澳洲田字草、迷你牛毛毡、矮生叉柱花和鹿角矮珍珠分布在底部，而莫丝、三叉铁皇冠和水榕则与印度小圆叶的“绿色”和红宝塔争夺山坡上的空间。

detail_list.name: Layout 77
descriptions: Last year I spent several months overseas with my job and wanted to create a nice aquascape upon my return home. This layout took a while to plan and I shared the whole process on the UKAPS forum (www.ukaps.org/forum). The journal has over 50,000 hits.

I originally was going to go for a rock-based design (Iwagumi) but eventually decided to use Manzanita Wood and Petrified Wood. I really wanted to try out a technique that I had recently heard about with moss. The moss is chopped up into very fine pieces then attached to the décor and grown out of water but in a humid environment.

I contacted Tropica and they recommended the use of a bio-yoghurt to mix with the moss. So I blended the moss (Riccardia chamedryfolia and Fissidens fontalus) with yogurt and reverse osmosis water in a handheld blender. I then simply attached the moss "paste" onto the wood and stones using a paintbrush.

I planted all of the other plants into wet soil (TMC NutraSoil) and covered the aquarium with glass. I misted the plants every day with reverse osmosis water mixed with a small amount of liquid fertiliser using a hand spray mister. This is known as the dry-start method.

After 3 weeks I flooded the aquarium and the moss remained attached to the rocks and woods, which was a big relief. The other plants grew well initially using the dry-start method but some species did not adapt very well to underwater life and melted.

For this reason I will only use the dry-start method for growing mosses in the future. The blender technique using yoghurt worked brilliantly and is perfect for attached very fine plants like Riccardia chamedryfolia.
Later in the aquascape's life I changed and added new plants. The best addition was Hemianthus 'Cuba' that has mixed with the mini hairgrass very nicely making a lovely texure in the foreground.
Tip! All the different kinds of plants require time and knowledge about maintenance.
descriptions_cn: 去年我在国外工作了几个月，回国后想创作一个漂亮的水草造景。这个造景构思花了好长时间，我在英国水草协会论坛（www.ukaps.org/forum）分享了整个创作过程。该论坛的点击量超过5万次。
我原本打算做一个以石头为主的造景（石组造景），但最终决定使用莫丝木和石化木。我真的很想尝试一种最近听说的技术。这种莫丝被切成非常细小的碎片，然后附着在装饰物上，在潮湿环境中生长。
我联系了Tropica，他们建议将生物酸奶与莫丝混合。所以我用手持搅拌器将珊瑚莫丝和美国凤尾苔（Fontalus）与酸奶和RO水混合成糊状。然后用刷子将莫丝糊固定在木头上和石头上。
我把所有其他水草种在湿土（TMC NutraSoil）里，然后用玻璃盖住了鱼缸。我每天用逆渗透水和少量液肥喷洒水草，这种方法称为干式开缸法。
三周后，我给水族箱注水，莫丝仍然附着在石头和沉木上，这让我松了口气。其他植物初期使用干式开缸法生长良好，但有些种类不适应水下生活，最终枯萎了。
因此，我以后种植莫丝只会使用干式开缸法。酸奶混合技术效果极佳，非常适合种植像珊瑚莫丝这样的附生细小水草。
后来，在造景作品的成长过程中，我更换并添加了新的植物。最棒的添加是迷你矮珍珠，它与迷你牛毛毡混合得非常好，为前景营造了美妙的纹理。
提示！所有不同种类的水草都需要时间和维护知识。

detail_list.name: Layout 76

technique.filter: Ext. JBL Cris.Pro GL e 90 or GL e 901

descriptions: Twelve different plants live in this aquarium, growing under the water surface, on tree roots and stones. The large hardscape in the middle, consisting of driftwood and mini landscape, is a vital part of the aquarium layout. On the journey through the aquarium, the viewer will continue to discover new things, e. g. small prawns, peeking out here and there from plant thickets or the hardscape. Since most of the plants also grow quickly, this will add constant change to the aquascape, which will never seem boring to the viewer.
Tip! All the different kinds of plants require time and knowledge about maintenance.

technique_cn.filter: Ext. JBL Cris.Pro GL e 90 or GL e 901

descriptions_cn: 这个水族箱中有十二种不同的水草，它们在水下、树根和石头上生长。中间的大骨架由沉木和小景构成，是造景的重要部分。在观赏过程中，观众会不断发现新事物，比如小虾从水草丛或骨架中探头探脑。由于大多数植物生长迅速，这将不断给造景带来变化，让观众永远不会感到无聊。
提示！所有不同种类的水草都需要时间和维护知识。

detail_list.name: Layout 75
descriptions: Red groups of Rotala macrandra and Alternanthera 'Mini' create focus plants in various shades of green - see video for a close up on the macrandra. The central tree root with mounted Christmas moss makes the aquarium look older, while the fresh green carpet of Cuba Hemianthus gives a light and friendly impression. Here, we used both Lilaeopsis and Cryptocoryne parva to break the passage between the central island and the front carpet. The darker green leaves of the Lilaeopsis and parva work well with the light green Hemianthus.
Tip! The tall Eleocharis is great for creating depth and perspective, since you can see through the straws.
descriptions_cn: 红蝴蝶和迷你血心兰 'Mini' 的红群形成焦点植物，各种绿色调相映成趣——请看视频近距离欣赏红蝴蝶的美丽。中央的树根上附着圣诞莫丝，让水族箱显得更加古老，而鲜绿色的迷你矮珍珠 珍珠草草坪则营造出轻快友好的氛围。我们使用了南美尖叶草皮和迷你椒草来打破中央岛屿和前景草坪之间的过渡，深绿色的南美尖叶草皮和迷你椒草与浅绿色的迷你矮珍珠 珍珠草相得益彰。
提示！长牛毛非常适合营造深度和透视感，因为可以看到穿过细茎的部分。

detail_list.name: Layout 74
descriptions: Symphony of light green Eleocharis parvula, Hottonia and Nymphoides with Microsorum 'Trident' and small stones with Spiky moss as a deep green contrast. The close, deep green wall of moss makes the overall impression soft and fertile, and it's actually not so hard to do (see video). The wall of moss also works as a "filter" inside the aquarium, since the quick growth of the moss soaks up nutrition from the water and thereby avoids algal growth. We recommend using moss directly from the lab, in order to avoid algae intake with the moss from the beginning.
Tip! Thin roots of redwood in the Eleocharis carpet create coherence between the plant island and the surrounding gravel.
descriptions_cn: 浅绿色的迷你牛毛毡、帕鹿雪花草和台湾水莲，搭配三叉铁皇冠与小石子，再以深绿色的松茸莫丝作对比。浓密的深绿色莫丝墙让整体显得柔和、丰茂，其实并不难制作（详见视频）。莫丝生长较快，能吸收水中养分，因此这面墙也能在缸内发挥一定的“过滤”作用，帮助抑制藻类。建议直接使用实验室培养的莫丝，以免开缸时随莫丝带入藻类。
提示！迷你牛毛毡草坪中的水松细根与植物岛和周围底砂形成了良好的连接。

detail_list.name: Layout 73
descriptions: Fifteen different plants inhabit this aquarium, allowing them to grow both over and under the water surface. The rugged hardscape and big variation in plants makes an impression of endless details. You will never finish because there is always more to discover. The rapid growth of most plants will add to this, creating constant change.
Tip! The many different plants takes a lot of time and skill to maintain.
descriptions_cn: 这个水族箱中有十五种不同的水草，它们既能生长在水面上，也能生长在水下。崎岖的骨架和植物种类的巨大差异营造出无限细节的印象。你永远无法完全欣赏完，因为总有很多细节等待发现。大多数植物的快速生长还会不断带来变化。
提示！各种不同的水草需要花费大量时间和技巧来养护。

detail_list.name: Layout 72
descriptions: Some well-chosen and carefully placed rocks, as well as Riccia, Hemianthus Cuba and Eleocharis. That's in fact all, in order to create this clean, vigorous meadow. You can almost hear the bees humming and you feel like going up to see, what's behind the horizon.
Tip! You can create depth and perspective with few means. It's simple.
descriptions_cn: 一些精心挑选并摆放的石头，搭配鹿角苔、珍珠草迷你矮珍珠和迷你牛毛毡。实际上就这些，为了营造这片干净而生机勃勃的草坪。你几乎能听到蜜蜂的嗡嗡声，仿佛想去看看地平线那边的景色。
提示！你可以用简单的手段营造深度和透视感。这很简单。

detail_list.name: Layout 71

technique.co2: 2 bubbles per second Via JBL kit
technique.fertiliser_weekly: 3ml ADA step 2, 5 drops green gain + 8 drops phyto

descriptions: A walk in Derbyshire has inspired this scape. From the meadow of Hemianthus callitrichoides 'Cuba' and swampy areas of Eleocharis, Staurogyne and Lilaeopsis marks the forest edge. Redwood covered in mosses, ferns and Anubias gives age to the forest, while young undergrowth of Hemianthus micranthemoides struggle for light underneath.
Tip! Moss tied to wood really gives age. Just remember, that most mosses will need to be re-tied now and then.

technique_cn.co2: 2 bubbles per second Via JBL kit

descriptions_cn: 这次在德比郡的漫步启发了这件造景。迷你矮珍珠和迷你牛毛毡构成的草地，与沼泽区域的矮生叉柱花和南美尖叶草皮标志着森林的边缘。覆盖着莫丝、蕨类和袖珍小榕的红木，为森林增添了岁月感，而珍珠草微生微兰特姆代斯科在下方争抢光线。
提示！莫丝绑在木头上真的能增加造景的年代感。请记住，大多数莫丝需要定期重新绑扎。

detail_list.name: Layout 70
descriptions: Massive pieces of hard rock are surrounded by large groups of plants, all with a very soft appearance. This creates a calm and pleasant atmosphere to the viewer. The warm, orange-red colors of Nesaea crassicaulis and Rotala 'Bonsai' are enhanced by the intense green of Pogostemon erectus, Heteranthera zosterifolia and Limnophila aquatica. Eleocharis 'Mini' will cover the substrate, without ever needing top-trimming.
Tip! The quite simple use of rocks and use of very few different plants is what makes this aquarium so peaceful.
descriptions_cn: 巨大的硬质岩石被大量植物包围，这些植物都呈现出非常柔和的外观，营造出一种宁静舒适的氛围。 Nesaea crassicaulis 和印度小圆叶的暖橙红色在直立百叶、罗丝草和大宝塔的浓郁绿色映衬下更加突出。迷你牛毛毡将覆盖底床，无需进行顶部修剪。
提示！仅使用少量石头和几种不同的水草，让这个水族造景显得格外宁静平和。

detail_list.name: Layout 69
descriptions: Ancient techniques of Bonzai are clearly the inspiration here. The lines and direction of wood in the hardscape are perfect. Choosing only plants with a soft and tiny appearance enhance the expression wanted. Only Myriophyllum mattogrossense and Hydrocotyle tripartite are really fast growing, so the amount of work, to maintain the expression is quite low.
Tip! Notice how much attention to details of hardscape means.
descriptions_cn: 古代盆景技术明显是灵感来源。硬景中的木材线条和方向非常完美。选择只有柔嫩小巧的植物来增强这种表达效果。只有雪花羽毛和三裂天胡荽生长较快，所以维持这种效果的工作量相对较低。
提示！注意硬景细节处理的重要性。

detail_list.name: Layout 68
descriptions: A burst of lush green spreads out from the left corner of this aquarium. Vallisneria 'Tiger' and Spiky-moss on wood creates an upright movement, caught by Microsorum 'Narrow' and 'Windeløv', passing it on to Staurogyne repens amongst the horizontal rocks and wood. Cryptocoryne 'Brown' and 'Petchii' add a little difference in color to the green shades.
Tip! The very bright substrate gives a ''sunny feeling'' to the whole scenery.
descriptions_cn: 左角蔓延出一片茂盛的绿色。虎纹水兰和莫丝点缀在沉木上，形成垂直的动感，被细叶铁皇冠和鹿角铁皇冠捕捉，传递给岩石和沉木间的矮生叉柱花。贝克椒草 'Brown' 和贝克椒草则为绿色调增添了一抹色彩差异。
提示！非常明亮的底床给整个造景带来了“阳光般”的感觉。

detail_list.name: Layout 67
descriptions: The classical valley, surrounded by plants with texture, form and colour. On the edge of the vigorous plain of Riccia stand Hydrocotyle Tripartita and Pogostemon Helferi and add to the fresh green. The play of colours in red-violet Ludwigia Glandulosa and Hygrophila Araguaia is beautifully highlighted by the intense, light green base colour. Rocks and aquarium glass are softened by Eleocharis, reflected effectively.
Tip! Riccia is fixed to small pieces of rock that need pruning and fixing on a regularly basis, in order to maintain the unique look.
descriptions_cn: 这片古典山谷被富有质感、形态和色彩的水草环绕。在鹿角苔形成的茂盛平原边缘，摆放着三裂天胡荽和喷泉太阳，增添了一抹清新的绿色。大红叶和阿拉瓜亚的深红紫色与强烈的浅绿色基底形成美丽的对比。岩石和水族玻璃通过迷你牛毛毡变得柔和，效果显著。
提示！鹿角苔固定在需要定期修剪和固定的较小岩石上，以保持其独特的外观。

detail_list.name: Layout 66
descriptions: A vigorous, green pearl, built after the "Dutch Style" with rows of green plants on different levels, but with a tree root. Hydrocotyle Tripartita with tiny, light green leaves create a vivid front. Lush Crypter in the middle slide almost unnoticeable into the deep silence between Bleheri's great leaves in the back. A couple of Echinodorus 'Reni' are used as contrast plants centrally in the aquarium.
Tip! Choosing only a few different plants adds a strong impression of peace and harmony.
descriptions_cn: 这是按照“荷兰风格”打造的一幅生机勃勃的绿色作品，不同层次的绿色植物排列有序，但加入了树根。三裂天胡荽以细小的淡绿色叶片营造出鲜活的前景。中景的椒草茂密丛生，几乎不显眼地融入到后景中贝尔里叶的巨大叶片之间。几株蕊妮皇冠草作为对比植物，被置于水族箱中央。
提示！只选择几种不同的水草能营造出强烈的宁静和谐感。

detail_list.name: Layout 65
descriptions: Diversity and vigour makes an aquarium exciting, but requires experience and a lot of maintenance. The shape of the leaves, colours and sizes have been thoroughly mixed in order to create life and diversity. Just as in nature, the plants are fighting for space and light. The strongest and fastest growing plants must be cut often to prevent them from suffocating the weaker plants. Obviously, ground covering plants must not be shaded, so it is important to thin out the floating plants intensively on a regular basis.
Tip! "Jungle"-style mixes a lot of different plants, but takes a great deal of practice. The result can easily get very messy.
descriptions_cn: 多样性和活力让水族箱充满生机，但这也需要经验和大量的维护。叶片的形状、颜色和大小被充分混合，以营造出生命力和多样性。就像自然界一样，植物在争夺空间和光线。生长最快最强壮的植物需要经常修剪，以防止它们窒息较弱的植物。显然，地被植物不能被遮挡，因此需要定期密集地清除浮叶植物。
提示！“丛林”风格的造景会使用很多不同种类的植物，但需要大量的练习。结果很容易变得非常杂乱。

detail_list.name: Layout 64
descriptions: A vigorous, deep-green wall of Weeping moss accentuates the orange-red Myriophyllum and the two light-green plants, Nymphoides and Hydrocotyle. The last-mentioned plant droops in cascades towards the low, dense Eleocharis mini, which elegantly brings out the small lobated leaves of Hydrocotyles. The warm, orange-red colour from Myriophyllum is also found in the tips of the group of Rotala sp. bonsai.
Tip! Light-green and red/purple plants placed closely together will always accentuate each other.
Note: Plant A on the drawing is Myriophyllum tuberculatum which is no longer produced by Tropica.
descriptions_cn: 茂盛的深绿色垂泪莫丝墙，衬托出橙红色的 Myriophyllum 属水草，以及浅绿色的台湾水莲和三裂天胡荽。三裂天胡荽呈瀑布状垂向低矮、浓密的迷你牛毛毡，其小巧的裂叶也因此更加突出。Myriophyllum 属水草温暖的橙红色，在印度小圆叶株丛的顶端也有所呼应。
提示！将绿色和红色/紫色的水草放在一起时，它们会相互衬托。
注意：图纸中的植物 A 是 Myriophyllum tuberculatum，Tropica 已不再生产此品种。

detail_list.name: Layout 63
descriptions: Easy and safe. All plants are able to handle relatively low lighting and no addition of CO2 - but better lighting and CO2 naturally gives a more beautiful result. Rotala will repay with reddish shoot tips and Eleocharis with a denser and more compact growth. The hardy Spiky moss has been divided into small tufts that have been tucked into the ground layer. The dark moss carpet suits the light-green Eleocharis really well.
Tip! As the selection of coloured plants in the green Easy category is limited, the use of coloured rocks is an obvious choice.
descriptions_cn: 易于养护且安全。所有植物都能适应相对较低的光照，无需补充 CO₂，但更好的光照和 CO₂ 补充会带来更美的效果。红宫廷的枝端会变成红色，迷你牛毛毡则会长得更密集紧凑。松茸莫丝被分成小团，植入底床中。深色的莫丝草坪与浅绿色的迷你牛毛毡非常搭配。
提示！由于绿植类中彩色植物的选择有限，使用彩色石头显然是一个明显的选择。

detail_list.name: Layout 62
descriptions: Lots of plants for the skilled aquarist. Vivid colours and vigorous growth require optimal lighting, as well as addition of the proper amount of fertilizer and CO2 - But other than that, it is really not that difficult. Hemianthus, Didiplis and Bolbitis all thrive in such good conditions, just as Rotala macrandra and mini-Alternanthera will develop optimal, deep-red colours.
Tip! A dark ground layer reflects less light than a light ground layer. Only use a very dark ground layer, when there is plenty of light on the aquarium.
Note: Plant "I" on the drawing is Myriophyllum tuberculatum which is no longer produced by Tropica. You can replace it by another red stem plant.
descriptions_cn: 适合有经验的水草玩家。鲜艳的颜色和旺盛的生长需要最佳光照，还需要适量的肥料和 CO₂。除此之外，其实并不难。珍珠草、Didiplis 和黑木蕨在这样的环境中生长茂盛，红蝴蝶和迷你血心兰也会发展出深红色的最佳色泽。
提示！底层颜色较深的底床反射的光线较少。只有在水族箱光照充足时，才使用非常深色的底床。
注意：图纸中的植物“I”是Myriophyllum tuberculatum，Tropica已不再生产。你可以用另一种红有茎草来替代。

detail_list.name: Layout 61
descriptions: Large and coloured leaves from Echinodorus, Nymphoides and Hygrophila are encircled by slim, grass-like leaves from Cyperus and tenellus. Moss tied to the large branches provides a sense of age and perspective, while the small islands of Riccia create focus points. Araguaia must regularly be trimmed hard backwards in order for it to stay low and dense.
Tip! Place red and purple plants in the middle of the aquarium, where there is most light. This provides the best possibilities for colour development.
descriptions_cn: 红香瓜草、台湾水莲和 Hygrophila 的大而色深的叶片被喷泉莎草和针叶皇冠草细长的叶片环绕。固定在大枝上的鹿角苔莫丝营造出年老的感觉，并提供视觉焦点。阿拉瓜亚需要定期后剪修剪，以保持低而密集的状态。
提示！将红色和紫色的水草放置在水族箱中间光照最充足的地方，这样有利于色彩的展现。

detail_list.name: Layout 60
descriptions: A really good beginner's aquarium with hardy plants that are able to thrive in low lighting and without the addition of CO2. However, better lighting and the addition of CO2 will show on the plants. Light and dark leaves in different sizes and forms make the image varied and exciting. Use coloured rocks to create contrasts, whenever the selection of coloured plants is limited. The image is framed by vigorous, deep-green Spiky-moss, which has been tucked into the ground layer in small tufts.
Tip! Vallisneria and Microsorum gently sway at the outlet of the pump, which creates life in the image.
descriptions_cn: 这是适合初学者的水草造景，使用了一些耐养的植物，这些植物在低光照和不添加 CO₂ 的情况下也能茁壮成长。不过，更好的光照和添加 CO₂ 会让植物表现得更好。大小和形态各异的深浅叶子让画面显得丰富多变。当彩色植物选择有限时，可以使用彩色石头来创造对比。画面四周被茂密的深绿色的刺莫丝所包围，这些刺莫丝被成簇地嵌入底床中。
提示！小水兰和细叶铁皇冠在水泵出口轻轻摇摆，为画面增添了生机。

detail_list.name: Layout 59

technique.gravel: ADA power sand Spec S,Aquasoil Africana,Nile sand

descriptions: James Starr-Marshall has visited Harborough Rocks in Peak District National Park in Derbyshire, England, and has been inspired to depict the robust as well as mobile landscape in the aquarium. The location of the rocks is an attempt to reproduce forms, lines and texture from the natural wonder with the creation of a plateau, from where groups of Hemianthus can droop down. Glossostigma has been selected as the slightly darker, green foreground, and the group of tenellus breaks the carpet plants towards the rock in the background.

Tip! The lighting of the white wall behind the aquarium gives the opportunity to create transitions from a more dark-greyish background at the bottom of the back wall sliding into a lighter grey colour towards the top of the back wall, and in this way the lighting contributes to the reproduction of the natural landscape.

technique_cn.gravel: ADA power sand Spec S,Aquasoil Africana,Nile sand

descriptions_cn: James Starr-Marshall 游览英格兰德比郡峰区国家公园的 Harborough Rocks 后，受到当地景观坚实而富有动势的形态启发，并将它表现到水草缸中。石材的位置借鉴了自然岩景的形态、线条与质感，中间搭出一处平台，让成丛的珍珠草从边缘垂落。前景选用颜色稍深的矮珍珠，并以一组针叶皇冠草打破草坪的连续感，过渡到后方石景。
提示！水族箱后方白色墙面的照明可以营造出从后墙底部较深的灰色渐变到顶部较浅灰色的效果，这样灯光有助于再现自然景观。

detail_list.name: Layout 58

technique.fertiliser_weekly: 7 ml Specialised Fertiliser + 7 ml Easy-Life Carb

descriptions: A classic layout that is easy to maintain with slow growing, easy plants - here with several Cryptocorynes and Microsorum. The layout has been built up around the nano root and the small, round stones in a Fluval Edge 46L with LED-lighting. Microsorum is the focus area and the different Crypts form the fore-, middle- and background. In the front, there is parva, low with small fresh green leaves. In the middle, there are several wendtii-types and in the back, there is balansae with the curly leaves. This selection of plants means that no trimming of the plants is required within the first couple of months.

Tip! George has applied used filter material which makes it possible for him to add Cardinal tetra immediately. Besides being beneficial to the environment for the fish, the reuse of the filter material also provides a faster balance in the aquarium.

technique_cn.fertiliser_weekly: 7 ml Specialised Fertiliser + 7 ml Easy-Life Carb

descriptions_cn: 这是一个经典的造景布局，使用生长缓慢、易于养护的植物——这里包括几种椒草和细叶铁皇冠。造景围绕着纳米根和小圆石构建，使用的是 Fluval Edge 46L 鱼缸，配备 LED 照明。细叶铁皇冠是造景的焦点区域，而不同的 Cryptocoryne 种类则构成了前景、中景和后景。前景是迷你椒草，低矮且叶片细小鲜绿；中景是几种绿温蒂椒草类型；后景则是巴兰萨伊，其叶片卷曲。这种植物选择意味着在最初的几个月内不需要修剪植物。
提示！George 使用了成熟的旧滤材，因此可以立即放入宝莲灯。旧滤材既能为鱼提供更稳定的环境，也能帮助水草缸更快建立平衡。

detail_list.name: Layout 54
descriptions: A world of 1-2-Grow! All variants are represented in this aquarium. The three tallest plants - Nymphoides, Rotala and Heteranthera - show up behind a mountain range of red granite. In between the large rocks, the moss is wedged and creates deep green glaciers. The clear, light green Riccia is tied to a couple of lava stones furthest to the left. Pogostemon and Staurogyne are accentuated in their leaf form as well as colour by Alternanthera, which together with Rotala creates focus areas. Eleocharis, moss, Hemianthus and Marselia, together with Glossostigma and Lilaeopsis, create a vigorous and varied plain landscape, where the little, compact Rotala 'Bonsai' shoots up here and there. A more harmonious and calm layout can be achieved by using a smaller amount of different foreground plants.

Tip! 1-2-Grow plants are smaller than normal pots by the planting and must have time to grow. It is therefore important to fertilize in small doses already from the beginning and gradually increase the dose in line with the growing plant mass.
descriptions_cn: 这套造景集中展示了 1-2-Grow! 系列。台湾水莲、Rotala 属水草和罗丝草三种高草从红色花岗岩山脉后方探出；大石之间塞入莫丝，形成深绿色的冰川状草丛，最左侧几块火山石上则绑着清亮的浅绿色鹿角苔。德干刺蕊草与矮生叉柱花的叶形和颜色，由迷你血心兰衬托得更加鲜明，后者再与 Rotala 属水草组成焦点。迷你牛毛毡、莫丝、珍珠草、田字草、矮珍珠和南美草皮共同铺成富于变化的平原，其间零星冒出紧凑的印度小圆叶。若减少前景草种类，整体构图会更平静、协调。
提示！种植时1-2-Grow植物比正常盆栽要小，必须有时间生长。因此，从开始就需要少量施肥，并随着植物生长量逐渐增加施肥量。

detail_list.name: Layout 53

technique.filter: Built-in filter back wall w/ 2 Eheim pumps 600 l/h

descriptions: Soft curves of erectus, Staurogyne and Heteranthera cling around large lava blocks. Hemianthus Cuba, Eleocharis and Marsilea create horizontal, calm surfaces, while focus areas of macrandra and Alternanthera create attention. All plants are from the 1-2-Grow! series. Directly from the laboratorium in small, sterile cups without any algae, snails or pesticides. The numerous growth areas on the 1-2-Grow plants make them significantly more dense and compact. Rotala macrandra and Rotala 'Bonsai are only represented in the 1-2-Grow programme and are unique and quite an eye catcher in this layout.

Tip! Moss from 1-2-Grow! is naturally also free from algae, snails and pesticides, and besides avoiding the growth of algae from moss, the moss from 1-2-Grow! is particularly suitable for aquariums with e.g. shrimps or other sensitive residents.

technique_cn.filter: Built-in filter back wall w/ 2 Eheim pumps 600 l/h

descriptions_cn: 直立百叶、矮生叉柱花和罗丝草以柔和的曲线围绕着大块火山石生长。迷你矮珍珠、牛毛毡和田字草铺出平缓的横向层次，红蝴蝶与血心兰则形成醒目的焦点。全部水草均来自 1-2-Grow! 系列，由实验室直接装入无菌小杯，不带藻类、螺和农药。1-2-Grow! 水草拥有较多生长点，因此株丛更浓密、紧凑。红蝴蝶和印度小圆叶当时仅在 1-2-Grow! 系列中供应，也是这套造景里格外抢眼的两种水草。
提示！来自1-2-Grow！的莫丝天然不含藻类、蜗牛和农药，除了避免莫丝生长藻类外，1-2-Grow！的莫丝特别适合含有虾或其他敏感居民的水族箱。

detail_list.name: Layout 52

technique.filter: Built-in filter back wall w/ 2 Eheim pumps 600 l/h

descriptions: A true abundance of details in vigorous, green hills of rocks and Christmas-moss makes you think of prehistoric landscapes. Pinnatifida, Bolbitis and Aponogeton are with their big leaves placed in the back. A wealth of small, varying leaf forms from Pogostemon, Ranunculus and Anubias populate the moss hills. Utricularia and Rotala sp. bonsai live in beautiful harmony in the little bog between the hills.

Tip! Utricularia is sensitive towards major environmental changes - e.g. by light intensity, or in water quality. Furthermore, the water circulation around the small, fine roots is important. Planting on porous stones, on a little lattice or on branches e.g. protected by moss will help the plant in the start-up.

technique_cn.filter: Built-in filter back wall w/ 2 Eheim pumps 600 l/h

descriptions_cn: 茂盛的绿色岩石群和莫丝山丘让人联想到史前景观。羽裂水蓑衣、黑木蕨和Aponogeton的大叶片位于后景。喷泉太阳、鹿角矮珍珠和袖珍小榕的小而多变的叶片填充了莫丝山丘。挖耳草和印度小圆叶在山丘之间的小泥沼中和谐共生。
挖耳草对环境变化非常敏感，比如光照强度或水质的变化。小而细的根部周围的水流也很重要。种植时可以将挖耳草种在多孔的石头、小格栅或树枝上，比如用莫丝保护，这样可以帮助植物在初期更好地适应。

detail_list.name: Layout 51
descriptions: Behind the old quarry, you will see the sunset of red Myriophyllum, Proserpinaca and Rotala over the edge of the wood of Hemianthus and erectus. In the front, Glossostigma and Eleocharis create a vigorous meadow, while Fissidens provides the rock slide with antiquity and grace. The beautiful play of colours from the intense orange red middle to the weaker red towards the sides is emphasized by a corresponding scenery of leaf forms from the fine-leafed middle to the lobed and whole-edged leaves.
Tip! Eleocharis is often used as ground cover, but can be placed very effectively in small tufts, in order to create contrast and break a uniform surface.
Note: Plant A on the drawing is Myriophyllum tuberculatum which is no longer produced by Tropica. Can ce replaced by another red stem plant.
descriptions_cn: 在旧采石场的后面，可以看到夕阳下红轮叶椒草、红丝苹和红宫廷从珍珠草和立叶珍珠草的边缘蔓延开来。前景中，矮珍珠和迷你牛毛毡营造出一片生机勃勃的草坪，而美国凤尾苔则赋予岩石滑坡古朴的韵味。从中间强烈的橙红色渐变到边缘较弱的红色，这种色彩的美丽变化通过中间的细叶逐渐过渡到边缘的裂叶和全缘叶的叶形变化而得到强调。
提示！迷你牛毛毡常用于铺设前景草坪，但也可以在小簇中摆放，以创造对比并打破单调的表面。
注意：图纸中的植物 A 为 Myriophyllum tuberculatum，Tropica 已不再生产，可更换为另一种红有茎草。

detail_list.name: Layout 50

technique.filter: Built-in filter back wall w/ 2 Eheim pumps 600 l/h

descriptions: Dramatic, upright dragon rocks in a calm, flat landscape of tenellus, Staurogyne and Hydrocotyle form the two classical islands with small details and the ravine in between. Hydrocotyle creates a light green glacier on one of them, while pinnatifida towers over the other. The mixture of red purple Aponogeton, Ludwgia and Hygrophila araguaia with fresh green Heteranthera and Rotala green beautifully accentuates both colours. Soft moss, Weeping and Christmas, soften up the somewhat sharp branches. The aquarium radiates peace and plenty of space.

Tip! The adequate amount of light (here approx. 1 watt per litre) gives the plants the opportunity to develop in the best way. This can clearly be seen in the beuatiful, compact growth and the intense development in the colours.
Note: Plant A on the drawing is Aponogeton crispus 'Red', which is no longer produced by Tropica. It can be replaced by Cryptocoryne Usteriana.

technique_cn.filter: Built-in filter back wall w/ 2 Eheim pumps 600 l/h

descriptions_cn: 挺拔的龙石立在由针叶皇冠草、矮生叉柱花和三裂天胡荽铺成的平缓景观中，组成两座带有细节的经典岛屿，中央留出峡谷。三裂天胡荽在其中一座岛上形成浅绿色的冰川状草丛，另一座则由羽裂水蓑衣向上伸展。红紫色的 Aponogeton 属水草、大红叶和阿拉瓜亚水蓑衣，与鲜绿色的罗丝草和绿宫廷相互衬托。垂泪莫丝与圣诞莫丝柔化了略显锐利的枝条，整缸呈现出安静、开阔的氛围。
提示！充足的光照（约每升水1瓦）能让植物以最佳方式生长。这在美丽的紧凑生长和鲜艳的颜色上表现得尤为明显。
请注意：图纸中的植物 A 是 Aponogeton crispus 'Red'，Tropica 已不再生产。可以使用气泡椒草替代。

detail_list.name: Layout 49

technique.filter: Built-in filter back wall w/Eheim pump 600 l/h

descriptions: The choice of only 4 different plants gives the aquarium an incredibly consistent, simple and harmonious image. The soft, calm lawn by Eleocharis 'Mini' (that stays low and does not require mowing) accentuates the forms and colours of Myriophyllum, Rotala sp. bonsai and Hydrocotyle, just like the merging in the colour tone of the fine-leafed, warm orange red Myriophyllum and the terminals on Rotala are very effective. Upright dragon rocks stop the fall from the right towards to the left for a short moment and allow the eye to linger on the details of each plant.

Tip! Please notice the diversity of especially the red-coloured plants. There are warm and cold shades with tones of e.g. orange, brown or purple. Choose red plants that harmonize in either the cold, minor undertone or the warm orange.
Note: Plant A on the drawing is Myriophyllum tuberculatum which is no longer produced by Tropica. Can ce replaced by another red stem plant.

technique_cn.filter: Built-in filter back wall w/Eheim pump 600 l/h

descriptions_cn: 仅选择4种不同的水草，赋予水族箱极富一致性、简单和谐的视觉效果。柔软平和的迷你牛毛毡（保持低矮无需修剪），突出迷迭香、印度小圆叶和三裂天胡荽的形态和色彩。迷迭香细腻的淡橙红色与印度小圆叶的色彩过渡非常自然。直立的龙岩阻挡了从右向左的视线流动，让目光停留在每种植物的细节上。
提示！请注意红叶植物的多样性。有暖色调和冷色调，比如橙色、棕色或紫色。选择红叶植物时，可以在冷色调的微色系或暖色调的橙色系中找到和谐的搭配。
注意：图纸中的植物 A 为 Myriophyllum tuberculatum，Tropica 已不再生产，可更换为另一种红有茎草。

detail_list.name: Layout 48

technique.gravel: Grain size 0.8-1.2 mm, black/Fiji from Unipac
technique.filter: Built-in filter back wall w/ 2 Eheim pumps 600 l/h

descriptions: The aquarium that looks great from the beginning and is easy to maintain. Echinodorus bleheri and Ludwigia grow fast and ensure, just like the numerous AquaDecor products, that the aquarium quickly reaches a fine biological balance. The numerous, big leaves and the large, dark lava blocks give the aquarium weight, piece and harmony. Echinodorus quadricostatus creeps out between the lava blocks. Spiky-moss and Cryptocorynes are growing vigorously on minor lava stones, and very small lava stones, spread out in the front, complete the image.
Tip! Large, calm fish will enhance the image of this aquarium. E.g. a couple of beautiful Discus (Symphysodon discus) or Scalare (Pterophyllum scalare) combined with a little shoal of Corydoras.

technique_cn.gravel: Grain size 0.8-1.2 mm, black/Fiji from Unipac
technique_cn.filter: Built-in filter back wall w/ 2 Eheim pumps 600 l/h

descriptions_cn: 这个从一开始就看起来很棒且易于维护的水草造景。亚马逊皇冠草和鲁宾叶底红生长迅速，确保和众多AquaDecor产品一样，水族箱很快达到良好的生物平衡。大量的大叶子和巨大的黑色玄武岩块赋予水族箱重量、稳定性和和谐感。皇冠草和四肋皇冠草在玄武岩块之间蔓延。尖刺莫丝和椒草在小型玄武岩石上生长旺盛，而散布在前景的小玄武岩石则完善了整个构图。
提示！大型且温和的鱼类可以增强这个水族造景的效果。例如，几对漂亮的蓝宝石丽鱼（Symphysodon discus）或红绿灯鱼（Pterophyllum scalare），搭配一小群 Corydoras 鲟鱼。

detail_list.name: Layout 47

technique.filter: Built-in filter in back wall w/Eheim pump 600 l/h

descriptions: The deep dark bottom layer accentuates the pale green Hygrophila and Helanthium (previously named Echinodorus) quadricostatus. Both are easy plants with a fresh and vigorous appearance. As a powerful contrast, you will see the darker Anubias and Microsorum, well surrounded by Spiky-moss and placed with each their tree root in the backmost corners. The orange red Ludwigia will catch your attention in this little, intimate place in the jungle river.
Tip! The obvious choice are small shoal fish with a reflection effect for this kind of aquarium, such as e.g. glowlight tetra (Hemigrammus erythrozonus) or neon tetra (Cheirodon axelrodii).

technique_cn.filter: Built-in filter in back wall w/Eheim pump 600 l/h

descriptions_cn: 深色的底层突出显示了淡绿色的泰国水蓑衣53B和四肋皇冠草。这两种植物容易养护，外观清新而旺盛。作为强烈的对比，可以看到更暗的袖珍小榕和铁皇冠，四周环绕着刺莫丝，每棵树的根部都放在最后面的角落。在小而私密的丛林河流中，橙红色的鲁宾叶底红会吸引你的注意。
提示！这个缸很适合饲养体形小、鳞片有反光效果的群游鱼，例如红灯管（Hemigrammus erythrozonus）或宝莲灯（Cheirodon axelrodii）。

detail_list.name: Layout 46

technique.light: 3 TMC Grobeam 500 Natural Daylight, 8 hours daily

descriptions: The plants from the Easy category are not only for starter aquariums - they are also used in large, luxuriant and lavish aquariums with minimum maintenance. Most plants have to be trimmed a few times a year and the aquarium will look luxuriant and healthy for a long time when you supply liquid fertilisers and CO2. It requires less than ½ hour of maintenance a week!

technique_cn.light: 3 TMC Grobeam 500 Natural Daylight, 8 hours daily

descriptions_cn: 这类易于养护的植物不仅适用于新手水族箱，也常用于大型、茂盛且豪华的水族箱，且几乎不需要太多维护。大多数植物一年需要修剪几次，只要提供液肥和 CO₂，水族箱就能保持茂盛和健康的状态很长时间。这只需要每周不到半小时的维护时间！

detail_list.name: Layout 45
descriptions: A natural layout with a focus on different shapes and colours. Even though the aquarium is full of colours, the plants used are relatively easy to care for. The aquarium is maintenance-friendly and will reach balance fast owing to many plants and a good composition of fast-growing plants at the back and front, and stable, easy plants in the middle of the aquarium.
descriptions_cn: 这是一款自然造景，注重不同形状和色彩。尽管鱼缸色彩丰富，但所用植物相对容易养护。造景维护简便，由于植物种类多样，生长速度快，鱼缸很快就能达到平衡状态。鱼缸后部和前部是快速生长的植物，中部则是稳定且容易养护的植物。

detail_list.name: Layout 44
descriptions: Mark has designed a dramatic rock landscape where the eye is caught in the light green, luxuriant foreground and guided towards the centre of the aquarium. Here we meet an abundance of colours and shapes. Dark green moss and a dense Tenellus forest frame the V-shaped edge. The colourful stem plants are challenging but if you succeed, they will be a nice contrast to the peaceful green foreground.
Note: Plant F on the drawing is Ludwigia arcuata, plant A is Alternanthera reineckii 'Purple' which are no longer produced by Tropica.
descriptions_cn: 马克设计了一个引人注目的岩石景观，视线被前景那片鲜绿色的茂盛水草吸引，然后引导至水族箱中心。在那里，色彩和形状丰富多样。深绿色的莫丝和密集的针叶皇冠草形成V形边缘的框架。色彩丰富的有茎草虽然具有挑战性，但如果成功种植，它们将与平静的绿色前景形成很好的对比。
注意：图纸中的植物 F 是 Ludwigia arcuata，植物 A 是血心兰 reineckii 'Purple'，Tropica 已经不再生产这两种植物。

detail_list.name: Layout 43

technique.gravel: Maui gravel, 2 cm by front screen, 8 cm in back

descriptions: The cube's 30 x 30 cm is perfect for a simple hardscape with only one root placed in the middle of the aquarium. The root will look more natural over time because it will be covered with moss. The shape of the root is suitable for Anubias. Cryptocoryne wendtii "Tropica" and Echinodorus "Reni" contribute to the red shades of the root which emphasise the fresh green Staurogyne in the foreground.
TIP! The symbols Easy, Medium and Advanced indicate the plant selection we recommend for your specific aquarium.

technique_cn.gravel: Maui gravel, 2 cm by front screen, 8 cm in back

descriptions_cn: 这个 30 x 30 厘米的立方体非常适合简单的骨架造景，只在水族箱中央放置一根根茎。随着时间推移，根茎会被莫丝覆盖，显得更加自然。根茎的形状适合小水榕。特罗皮卡温蒂椒草、特罗皮卡温蒂椒草和皇冠草（蕊妮皇冠草）为根茎增添了红色调，突出了前景中矮生叉柱花的新鲜绿色。
提示！符号Easy、Medium和Advanced表示我们为您特定水族箱推荐的植物种类。

detail_list.name: Layout 41
descriptions: The large, dead rainforest tree makes room for an abundance of new growth. A thick wall of red and green Aponogeton, stellata and Hemianthus falls softly from the right to the left in the back of the aquarium. Echinodorus 'Reni' and 'Araguaia' create, along with Alternanthera, colourful focus points. The thick, dark mosses give the layout a sense of age and character as a contrast to the vigorous, light-green Hemianthus carpet that covers the entire foreground of the aquarium.
The schooling fish "Harlequin" (Rasbora heteromorpha) would be a suitable fish to adorn this show-aquarium.
