Tips! The use of green as well as red Aponogeton crispus provides a beautiful sparkle with the different shades and their texture - both plants have slim, long and slightly curly leaves, which wave beautifully in the water stream from the pump.
Note: Plant E on the drawing is Aponogeton crispus 'Red' which is no longer produced by Tropica. Can be replaced by Cryptocoryne usteriana.

technique_cn.fertiliser_weekly: 40 ml Premium 液肥 + 80 ml Specialised 液肥

descriptions_cn: 巨大的雨林枯木为繁茂的新生水草留出了空间。水族箱后方，红绿相间的 Aponogeton 属水草、百叶草和珍珠草形成一道厚实的草墙，从右向左柔和地倾泻下来。蕊妮皇冠草、阿拉瓜亚水蓑衣和血心兰构成几处鲜明的色彩焦点。浓密的深色莫丝赋予造景岁月感和个性，与铺满整个前景、长势旺盛的浅绿色迷你矮珍珠草坪形成对比。
这种 schooling fish "哈莱金"（Rasbora heteromorpha）是装饰这个展示缸的好选择。
提示！使用绿色和红色的阿帕诺杰顿旋卷草（Aponogeton crispus），它们不同的色调和质感为造景增添了美丽的亮点。这两种植物都拥有细长且略带卷曲的叶片，在水泵水流的作用下，叶片在水中优美地摇曳。
请注意：图纸中的植物 E 是 Tropica 不再生产的 Aponogeton crispus 'Red'。可以使用气泡椒草替代。

detail_list.name: Layout 40

technique.light: T5 2 x 28W T5, High Lite Day

descriptions: A pure and cultured landscape with everything in the right spot. Light and friendly. The very light-green general impression from Ceratopteris, Rotala, Hydrocotyle and Nymphoides is broken by the red Echinodorus, the orange Nesaea and the orange-green pinnatifida. Under the pinnatifida, the 'Christmas'-moss grows. To the right, the 'Spiky'-moss forms a dark, somewhat mysterious surface - and at the same time covers the filter! Pinnatifida and Staurogyne are both regularly nipped to further a low and compact growth. Rotala is kept low like a valley in the background. Keep the rock pieces visible between the plant groups.
Schooling fish are an obvious choice for the aquarium - as an example the Red Nose Tetra (Hemigrammus bleheri, approximately 15 fish.).
Tips! Keep an area free up against the front screen, so that offshoots from Staurogyne, pinnatifida and Hydrocotyle are free to peep out and be visible.

technique_cn.light: T5 2 x 28W T5, High Lite Day

descriptions_cn: 这套造景清爽雅致，各种元素各得其所，整体明亮柔和。水蕨、Rotala 属水草、三裂天胡荽和台湾水莲构成浅绿色基调，红色皇冠草、橙色粗茎水苋和橙绿色羽裂水蓑衣则打破单一的绿色。羽裂水蓑衣下方生长着圣诞莫丝，右侧的松茸莫丝形成深色而略带神秘感的表面，同时遮住过滤器。羽裂水蓑衣和矮生叉柱花需要经常打顶，以维持低矮紧凑；后景的 Rotala 属水草也压低修剪，形成山谷。各组水草之间要留出可见的石块。
这个缸很适合饲养群游鱼，例如约 15 条红鼻剪刀（Hemigrammus bleheri）。
提示！前玻璃附近留出一片空地，让矮生叉柱花的侧枝，以及羽裂水蓑衣和三裂天胡荽的新芽能够自由伸展并露出来。

detail_list.name: Layout 39
descriptions: Deep in the jungle, the large tree sticks its roots into a dark spring. Here, the little Anubias 'Petite' finds its foothold with the 'Spiky'-moss. The moss is particularly suitable for growth on vertical roots. Cryptocoryne 'Tropica' stretches its brown-coloured leaves out into the light from its place under the tree roots. Monosolenium thus thrives in the dark as well as the light near the surface - the scale moss takes up a lot of space with the wide leaves.

A red fighting fish (Betta splendens) would be a suitable choice to provide colour and sparkle in the small aquarium - besides the fighting fish, we recommend ram's horn snails, shrimps and Otocinclus affinis to keep the aquarium clean and free from algae.

Tips! All the chosen plants grow slowly and make the aquarium very easy to maintain - after the running-in, the aquarium requires a 25% change of water every second week and a little fertilizer, and months between having to cut the plants. The Ranunculus did not thrive in this set-up and was exchanged for Monosolenium on small rocks.
descriptions_cn: 在丛林深处，大树的根系伸入一个黑暗的泉水中。在这里，迷你水榕找到了生长点，旁边是“刺状”莫丝。“刺状”莫丝特别适合在垂直根系上生长。特罗皮卡温蒂椒草“特罗皮卡温蒂椒草”从大树根下伸展出棕色的叶片，吸收光线。因此，莫丝在光线充足和接近水面的暗处都能茁壮生长，其宽大的叶片占据了大量空间。
一条暹罗斗鱼（Betta splendens）能为这个小缸增添色彩和光泽。除此之外，建议放入扁卷螺、虾和小精灵（Otocinclus affinis），帮助保持缸内清洁并控制藻类。
提示！所选水草生长都较慢，因此维护很轻松。系统稳定后，每两周换水 25% 并添加少量液肥即可，往往几个月才需要修剪一次。鹿角矮珍珠在这套造景中状态不佳，后来换成了绑在小石块上的珊瑚莫丝。

detail_list.name: Layout 38
descriptions: Red granite stones and solid mangrove roots build up the hardscape in this aquarium. With the good lighting and CO2 supply the compact, reddish araguaia and the slim Proserpinaca and arcuata find their right place. The somewhat demanding Utricularia has found foothold at the bottom of the Spiky moss which together with Monosolenium form a picture frame in the middle of the aquarium. A solid bottom cover of Eleocharis, helferi and Hydrocotyle create contrast and bring out each other's leaf structures.

Tip! Be careful with stones and roots close to the front glass pane. Optically, these move even more to the front of the aquarium when it is filled with water, which can obstruct the cleaning of the front glass pane.
Note: Plant C on the drawing is Ludwigia arcuata which is no longer produced by Tropica.
descriptions_cn: 红色花岗岩与粗壮的红树根材构成这个缸的骨架。充足的光照和 CO₂ 供应，为株形紧凑、带红色的阿拉瓜亚水蓑衣，以及线条纤细的古巴锯齿草和 arcuata 提供了合适环境。较难养的挖耳草在尖叶莫丝下方扎根，尖叶莫丝与珊瑚莫丝共同围出缸体中部的画框式构图。底部由迷你牛毛毡、喷泉太阳和三裂天胡荽密集覆盖，三者相互衬托，各自的叶形也更突出。
提示！注意前方玻璃缸壁附近的石头和根部。在水族箱注满水后，这些石头和根部会显得更靠近前方，可能阻碍前玻璃缸壁的清洁。
注意：图纸中的植物 C 是 Ludwigia arcuata，Tropica 已不再生产此品种。

detail_list.name: Layout 37

technique.gravel: Corn size 0.8-1.2 mm, blue and black

descriptions: The large filter box on the right side of the aquarium invites to a diagonal layout, falling to the left. Light green Cardamine and red Ludwigia start the falling line which continues downwards with deep green Bolbitis and finishes with light green erectus and ranunculus. A large spider-like root breaks the stiff line and together with Reni gives the aquarium depth. Tenellus, ranunculus and helferi make a rich carpet that gives the picture a final touch.
Tips! Think about the colours and structure of the rocks and bottom layer. Raw and mat materials in grey and black are used here to blend in with the aquarium and the filter box.

technique_cn.gravel: Corn size 0.8-1.2 mm, blue and black

descriptions_cn: 右侧的大滤盒邀请了对角线构图，向左下延伸。浅绿色的苹果草和红色的鲁宾叶底红拉开了下落的线条，深绿色的黑木蕨继续向下延伸，最后以浅绿色的直立百叶和鹿角矮珍珠结束。一个大而像蜘蛛的根系打断了僵硬的线条，并与蕊妮皇冠草一起给水族箱增加了深度。针叶皇冠草、鹿角矮珍珠和喷泉太阳形成了丰富的草坪，为画面增添了最后的点缀。
提示！要考虑岩石和底床的颜色和结构。这里使用了灰色和黑色的粗糙和哑光材料，以与水族箱和过滤箱融为一体。

detail_list.name: Layout 36
descriptions: The modest amount of light and no CO2 limit the choice of plants to the most robust ones. The layout is based initially on structures, forms and colours. The round, dark marine gravels and Anubias, Monosolenium and Cryptocryne Tropica create the underlying peace in the aquarium. The spider-like root, quadricostatus and Winde leaves by their light colours and "sharpness" create a strong contrast and give the impression of life and restlessness. The leaves of the soft, light green Nymphoides are under the surface.
Tips! Allow just the most robust and shadow-tolerant plants under other plants. Here, Anubias and Cryptocoryne Tropica are very shaded under the Microsorum Winde leaves.
descriptions_cn: 光照较弱且不添加 CO₂，因此只能选择最皮实的水草。构图从结构、形态和色彩出发：圆润的深色海砂、小水榕、珊瑚莫丝和特罗皮卡温蒂椒草奠定安静的基调；蜘蛛般伸展的根枝、四肋皇冠草和鹿角铁皇冠叶片颜色较浅、线条锐利，形成强烈对比，让画面更有动势。柔软的浅绿色台湾水莲叶片则贴近水面展开。
提示！其他水草下方只适合种植皮实、耐阴的品种。这里的小水榕和特罗皮卡温蒂椒草，就处在鹿角铁皇冠叶片投下的浓荫中。

detail_list.name: Layout 35
descriptions: Rich tropical pond with great water depth. We see a colour play in the selection of plants and the theme is a place of calmness, darkness and some mystique. Because of the great water depth very little light reaches the bottom. Vesuvius is set up in a quiet background so that its characteristic growth does itself justice. The background falls from left to right in a mixture of colours and leaf shapes. Fresh green plants decorate the middle and the foreground and create a nice contrast to the dark roots. A mixture of the dark "Spiky" moss and Utricularia. The aquarium is intended for neon fish and other shining shoal fish.

Tips! Wood roots release acids into the water that colour it yellow. This can be avoided by keeping the roots under water before using them in the aquascape- and afterwards, by frequent water changes.
Note: Plant A on the drawing is Echinodorus uruguayensis which is no longer produced by Tropica. Can be replaced by Echinodorus bleheri.
descriptions_cn: 这是一个丰富的热带水景造景，水深很大。植物的选择营造了色彩的对比，主题是宁静、昏暗和神秘。由于水深，底部几乎见不到光线。在安静的背景中放置了维苏威火山石，使其独特的生长形态得以展现。背景从左至右以多种颜色和叶片形状交织。鲜绿色的植物装饰中景和前景，与深色的根部形成鲜明对比。深色的“刺毛”莫丝和猪笼草混搭。这个造景适合养霓虹鱼和其他亮色的群游鱼。
提示！木头根部会释放酸性物质使水变黄。使用前可将根部浸泡在水中，使用后则需频繁换水以避免此现象。
注意：图纸上的植物A是蕊妮皇冠草uruguayensis，该品种已不再由Tropica生产，可以替换为亚马逊皇冠草。

detail_list.name: Layout 34
descriptions: The large old tree at the edge of the wood leaning over the open meadow and the light playing and breaking in the tree crown (Bolbitis). The tree crown creates areas of flickering shadows and there is Cardamine in light openings for a fresh green background. Cryptocoryne is planted in the shadow areas. Moss on branches gives the tree an air of richness and antiquity. Behind the tree, Rotala creates a falling line. The corner filter is partially camouflaged by Fissidens on a suspended root. The many plants in the aquarium are in good balance - tenellus and stem plants require regular trimming.

Tips! The location of Bolbitis near the water surface/light source creates splendid effects in the aquarium when the water flow moves the leaves of the Bolbitis and light and shadows form waves in the tenellus carpet.
descriptions_cn: 林缘的一棵老树向开阔草地倾斜，光线穿过由黑木蕨构成的树冠，在下方投出摇曳的斑驳树影。苹果草生长在透光处，为背景添上一层清新的绿色；椒草则种在阴影中。枝条上的莫丝让老树显得繁茂而有年代感，树后方的 Rotala 属水草拉出一道向下延伸的线条。角落过滤器被悬垂根枝上的凤尾苔遮住一部分。缸内水草整体保持良好平衡，但针叶皇冠草和有茎草仍需定期修剪。
提示！黑木蕨靠近水面/光源的位置，在水流移动黑木蕨的叶片时，会在针叶皇冠草的草坪上形成光影波纹的美丽效果。

detail_list.name: Layout 33
descriptions: The layout is a play with the interior and the theme in correlation with limited light conditions and no CO2 supply. A relaxed layout with room for fun. Anubias and Microsorum are robust and shadow-tolerant. Ludwigia, Pogostemon and Nymphoides can grow without CO2 and offer different leaf forms and light colours. The moss grows slowly without CO2 and with little light, and are used here as short plants (bound to stones) and as funny balls freely floating in the water. The layout is maintenance-friendly and decorative.
Tips! Moss can be used in many ways - as here, for example, where the moss is tied to a plastic grated ball and fixed to the substrate with a fishing line and an anchor buried in the gravel.
descriptions_cn: 造景以室内环境和主题为灵感，适应有限的光照条件和无 CO₂ 供应的情况。构图轻松，留有发挥空间。小水榕和铁皇冠生命力强，耐阴。鲁宾叶底红、喷泉太阳和台湾水莲在无 CO₂ 的情况下生长良好，提供多种叶片形态和光色。莫丝在无 CO₂ 和光照不足的情况下生长缓慢，用作固定在石头上的矮生植物和自由漂浮的有趣小球。整体构图易于维护且装饰性强。
提示！莫丝可以用多种方式使用，例如像这里展示的，将莫丝绑在塑料网球上，再用钓鱼线固定在底床上，并在砂粒中埋入一个锚。

detail_list.name: Layout 32
descriptions: Mark Evans has designed and maintained this 360 liter full glass aquarium with CO2 addition and plenty of light. Mark here shows calm woodland on each side of a small gorge. In focus are beautiful, ruby colors from glandulosa and crispus 'Red'. This is supported by dark green colors from different Crypts, Bolbitis and Microsorum. The vigorous Weeping-moss with the small, light "tears" completes the transition from rocks to gravel. An elegant background is made by primarily light green stem plants behind the more robust leaf textures in the woodland areas.
Tip! Consider your background carefully. Try different colours - for example by using coloured card and see how different the aquarium looks. Or as here, by choosing light green stem plants.
Note: Plant E on the drawing is Aponogeton crispus 'Red' which is no longer produced by Tropica. Can be replaced by Cryptocoryne usteriana.
descriptions_cn: 马克·埃文斯设计并维护了一个360升的全玻璃水族箱，使用了CO₂和充足的光照。马克在这次造景中展现了两侧有森林的狭谷景象。焦点在于大红叶和crispus 'Red'的美丽红宝石色。这些色彩得到了不同Crypt属植物、黑木蕨和细叶铁皇冠的深绿色的衬托。活泼的垂蔓莫丝和它的小而亮的“泪滴”完成了从岩石到底砂的过渡。轻盈的绿色有茎草作为背景，衬托出森林区域更为粗犷的叶片纹理。
提示！请仔细考虑背景的设计。尝试使用不同颜色的卡片，看看对水族箱外观的影响。或者像这里一样，选择浅绿色的有茎草。
注意：图纸上的植物 E 是特罗皮卡温蒂椒草培育的红纹马蹄莲，现已不再生产。可替换为气泡椒草。

detail_list.name: Layout 31
descriptions: Dan Crawford has designed and maintained "Fish Box 40" from Pets at Home. There is light enough so that medium difficulty plants can grow when CO2 is added. The layout shows the vigorous forest with trees branches, colours from dark green to reddish and many different leaf textures. Centrally, Dan uses Nano Sumatra wood. Behind the wood-pieces and directly underneath the light source the Ludwigia adds color to the layout. Petchii is in the back, Eleocharis in center and helferi in front creates a pleasant transition in the aquarium from back to front. Ranunculus mixes with helferi in the front of the tank and grows well in the dense under-forest.
Tip! Most Cryptocorynes do well also in corners of the aquarium where light often is limiting compared to centrally in the aquarium.
descriptions_cn: Dan Crawford 负责设计和维护 Pets at Home 的“Fish Box 40”。添加 CO₂ 后，缸内光照足以支持中等难度的水草。构图表现一片枝干交错的茂密森林，色彩从深绿延伸到红褐，叶片质感也各不相同。中央使用 Nano Sumatra 沉木；沉木后方、灯具正下方的大红叶为画面增色。后景的贝克椒草、中景的迷你牛毛毡和前景的喷泉太阳形成自然过渡，鹿角矮珍珠与喷泉太阳混种在前景，并在浓密的林下区域生长。
提示！大多数椒草也能在光照不足的角落生长得很好，相比之下，中央区域的光照更充足。

detail_list.name: Layout 30
descriptions: George Farmer has designed and maintained the Cube from Pets at Home. The layout is suitable for newcomers to the hobby. Chosen plants are easy and don't require CO2 injection to grow and thrive. Rotala is easy, compact and here the color is fresh green. Rotala can become redder having more light. Quadricostatus adds to the green aquarium and in front, the Ranunculus umbrellas make shapes and structure. There are many plants in relation to the volume of water which ensures that the aquarium is in balance and provides less risk of algae. The growth of the plants is slowly and keeps the aquarium low maintenance.
Tip! Cubes are small and can be placed almost everywhere at home. They are suitable for small fish and/or shrimps - however, be careful not to add too many!
descriptions_cn: 乔治·弗默设计并维护了宠物之家的立方体造景。这个造景适合新手。选择的植物易于养护，不需要 CO₂ 补充就能生长良好。红宫廷草简单紧凑，颜色鲜绿。增加光照可以使红宫廷草变得更红。四肋皇冠草为水族箱增添绿色，而鹿角矮珍珠草在前方形成形状和结构。植物数量较多，与水体体积相匹配，确保水族箱平衡并减少藻类生长的风险。植物生长缓慢，使水族箱维护简单。
提示！立方体很小，几乎可以放在家里的任何地方。它们适合养小型鱼和/or虾，但请注意不要放太多！

detail_list.name: Layout 29
descriptions: "Mangrove Tree" is scpaed in a cube of 30 L with LED light. The aquarium is built using thin desert wood roots that form a small mangrove tree on aerial roots. White cichlid sand with small pebbles constitutes the bottom layer of the layout. The layout concept was to create a hardscape that gave the illusion of a river bank covered by mangrove trees on aerial roots. A desert wood root with many small thin branches was therefore placed with the fine branches pointing downwards. A similar root with the small branches pointing upwards was placed on it. In-between the two roots, Bolbitis heudelottii was fixed and small pieces of weeping moss were also tied here and there on the top thin branches. Try to tie the moss so that it covers the unnatural cross-section surfaces left by the saw as well as where it was necessary to shorten the branches. Anubias barteri var. nana was used to cover the filter placed at the back left corner of the aquarium.

Tips! The LED light is only 7 Watt and it is therefore insufficient for light-demanding plants at the bottom of the relatively high cube. Use therefore plants that do not require so much light such as moss, Anubias, Microsorum or Bolbitis at the bottom of the aquarium.
descriptions_cn: “红树林”造景作品使用了一个30L的立方体水族箱，并配备了LED灯光。造景中使用了细沙漠木根，形成了一棵悬根的红树林。白色慈鲷沙和小鹅卵石构成了造景的底床。构想是营造出一条河岸的景象，上面覆盖着悬根的红树林。因此，放置了一根有许多细小枝条的沙漠木根，细枝向下。在它上面放置了一根小枝向上生长的类似根系。在两根根系之间，固定了黑木蕨（Heudelottia nigricans），并在顶部细枝上绑上了少量垂泪莫丝（Drosera sp.）。尽量将莫丝绑在锯切后不自然的横截面表面以及需要修剪枝条的地方，使其覆盖住这些区域。小水榕（Microsorum pteropus）被用来覆盖放置在水族箱左后角的过滤器。
提示！LED 灯只有 7 瓦，因此对于较高水族箱底部的高光需求植物来说不够。因此，在底部使用如莫丝、小水榕、铁皇冠或黑木蕨等低光需求植物。

detail_list.name: Layout 28
descriptions: "Desert Wood 54L" is an open aquarium with a nice little moss and Anubias barteri "Petite", which is a dwarf variant of the ordinary Anubias barteri var. nana. The aquarium requires some maintenance so that it will not turn into a jungle within a few months. "Desert Wood 54L" consists of a pair of large desert roots - the thin, very twisted roots that became popular a few years ago. The bottom layer consists of white cichlid sand with large pieces of red fossilised wood and pebbles the size of a walnut from the nearby gravel pit. The pebbles form a sharp borderline with the white cichlid sand. The aquarium is open and it is thus possible to allow the plants to grow out of it - in this case ordinary Anubias barteri var. nana stick out of the water on the left at the back.

Tips! The small fine java moss grows considerably more slowly than the ordinary java moss and is thus well suited for aquariums where trimming must take place less often than what is otherwise required.
descriptions_cn: “Desert Wood 54L”是一个开放式水族箱，里面有一小片莫丝和一小丛水榕 barteri “袖珍小榕”，这是一种普通小水榕的矮小变种。这个水族箱需要定期维护，否则几个月内可能会变成一片丛林。“Desert Wood 54L”由一对大型沙漠根构成——这些根几年前因为形状细长且扭曲而变得流行。底床由白色慈鲷砂组成，搭配大块红色化石木和核桃大小的砾石。这些砾石与白色慈鲷砂形成鲜明对比。水族箱是开放式的，因此植物可以生长出水面，例如，在后方左侧，普通小水榕的枝条伸出水面。
提示！爪哇莫丝（*Javanica*）细小品种的生长速度明显慢于普通爪哇莫丝，因此非常适合那些修剪频率低于普通需求的水族箱。

detail_list.name: Layout 27
descriptions: "Wooden Bridge" is a genuine low-maintenance aquarium which was originally intended for the slowly growing Anubias barteri var. nana. It is supposed to survive the summer with rare water changes and almost no maintenance as far as trimming is concerned. "Wooden Bridge" consists of two large islands made of Øland rocks with white cichlid sand as bottom layer. A more than 1 metre long bent mangrove root connects the two islands and fills the volume of the aquarium so that the entire height is utilised. Small Anubias barteri var. nana on tree roots are placed around the rocks and on the big mangrove root. Two natural notches to the right of the hardscape and a single one to the left is where you can experiment with exciting plants without having to rearrange the whole hardscape. In the beginning, these "available" places were taken by Ranunculus inundates and Rotala macranda "Japan".

Tips! Turn down the light - this way the plants will grow more slowly and will require trimming more rarely as compared to when the roots are strongly lit. If you cannot bolt your fittings, you can instead place a layer of black tulle as a shading net under the fittings.
descriptions_cn: “Wooden Bridge”是一款真正的低维护水草造景缸，最初是为慢生的小水榕设计的。它只需极少的换水和修剪，几乎不需要维护就能安全度过夏天。“Wooden Bridge”由两座由奥兰群岛岩石制成的大岛屿组成，底层覆盖着白色慈鲷沙。超过1米长的弯曲红树林根将两座岛屿连接起来，填充了整个水族箱的体积，充分利用了高度。小水榕的树根围绕着岩石和大红树林根放置。硬景右侧有两个自然凹槽，左侧有一个凹槽，可以用来试验不同的植物，而无需重新布置整个硬景。起初，这些“预留”的位置被鹿角矮珍珠和红蝴蝶“日本”占据。
提示！降低光照强度，这样植物生长会变慢，修剪的频率也会降低。如果你不能遮挡灯具，可以在灯具下方放置一层黑色蕾丝布作为遮光网。

detail_list.name: Layout 26
descriptions: Mark Evans has aquascaped this "Iwagumi" layout. First, Mark arranges the fresh green, a shallow and vital foreground carpet. Between Hemianthus and the dark rocks there are tufts of Ranunculus. Behind the rocks there are light draperies of Rotala and on the side, where the rocks penetrate the sand, tufts of Eleocharis. Mark has attached blue foil to the aquarium and with light effects during photoshoots he achieves a blue sky over the fresh green layout.
Tip! Mark's layout is a good example of an aquarium where a few plant species give the impression of a pure style aquarium.
descriptions_cn: Mark Evans 造景了一个 Iwagumi 构图。首先，他布置了一个浅色而生机勃勃的前景草坪，由珍珠草构成。在珍珠草和深色岩石之间，点缀着鹿角矮珍珠的丛生。岩石后面是红宫廷的轻柔垂幕，在岩石穿透沙床的侧面，则是迷你牛毛毡的丛生。Mark 在水族箱上贴上了蓝色箔纸，并通过拍摄时的光线效果营造出一片蓝色天空覆盖在鲜绿色的前景上。
提示！Mark 的造景是一个很好的例子，展示了仅用几种植物种类就能营造出纯粹风格水族造景的效果。

detail_list.name: Layout 24
descriptions: The light on this 50-litre "start set" is just 15 Watt. The exceptionally simple layout and few, robust and slowly growing plants make the aquarium almost maintenance-free. Trimming of the plants is limited to no more than once every six months. If you keep a limited number of fish - such as 4 small veiltail goldfish or approx. 10 small shoal fish - there will hardly be any algae growth and there will be no problem to minimise water changes to approx. 25% every other week. (Veiltail goldfish grow big - and may need to be moved to a larger tank after some time. Please refer to your dealer's recommendations).
Tips! Playing with colourful gravel is adventurous in aquariums where minimum light limits the choice of plants to Anubias and a few other robust plant species.
descriptions_cn: 这个 50 升的“干式开缸”仅使用 15 瓦灯光。构图极其简单，且植物种类少、生长缓慢，几乎不需要维护。植物修剪只需每六个月一次。如果养少量鱼类，如 4 条小水泡眼金鱼或约 10 条小群游鱼，几乎不会出现藻类生长，可以将换水频率减少到每两周约 25%。请注意，水泡眼金鱼会长大，可能需要移到更大的鱼缸，请参考经销商的建议。
提示！在光照不足的水族箱里，只能选择种植水榕和其他几种健壮的植物，用彩色底砂营造变化多端的效果非常冒险。

detail_list.name: Layout 23

technique.gravel: ELOS Terra Small + Exoterra Riverbed Sand Brown

descriptions: Oliver Knott has made a layout which only contains new items from Tropica in 2010 in Kölle Zoo in Ludwigshafen. Here Oliver shows the colours that Pinnatifida can develop and the many uses of Pinnatifida in the aquarium. Centrally there is a large group with Pinnatifida, which runs in strings backwards to both sides between the two transversal stone groups. In the foreground Oliver uses Weeping moss as a low, padded growth. Pogostemon erectus forms a larger group in the back transposed from the middle, which separates the background in a calm right-hand part with small growth and in a wilder left-hand part where both Polygonum and Vesuvius contribute to the forest of stems, branches and leaves.
Tip! The eye catcher in this layout is Pinnatifida's red-violet play of colours and leaf characteristics - a result which is only achieved at light amounts over 0.5 Watt/litre and addition of CO2.
Note: Plant F on the drawing is Polygonum sp. which is no longer produced by Tropica.

technique_cn.gravel: ELOS Terra Small + Exoterra Riverbed Sand Brown

descriptions_cn: 奥利弗·诺特在路德维希港的Kölle Zoo用2010年Tropica公司的新品制作了一个水草造景。在这里，奥利弗展示了羽裂水蓑衣可以展现出的色彩以及它在水族箱中的多种用途。中央位置摆放着一大丛羽裂水蓑衣，它以串状向两侧延伸，穿插在两组横向的石头之间。前景部分，奥利弗使用垂泪莫丝作为低矮的垫状生长。直立百叶则在后方形成一个较大的群体，从中间转移到后方，将背景分为右侧较为平静的小生长区域和左侧更为茂密的区域，其中包含了Polygonum和Vesuvius，共同营造出一片枝叶繁茂的有茎草森林。
提示！这款造景的焦点是羽裂水蓑衣的红紫色彩和叶片特征——只有在光照强度超过0.5瓦/升并且添加了CO₂的情况下才能实现。
注意：图纸中的植物F是Polygonum sp.，Tropica已不再生产此品种。

detail_list.name: Layout 22
descriptions: The Dutch aquarium is aquascaped by George Farmer and is described in Practical Fish Keeping - an aquascape with an abundance of plants in rows and groups. Many stem plants with variations in structure and colour give a visual effect - and challenges! George's largest challenge in planning the aquascape was the choice of plants and placement, and making sure they complemented each other. George grouped plants in the foreground, middle ground and background with a colour sub-category, and chose a combination of classical Dutch plants (like Lobelia and Bacopa) as well as several new plants (like Staurogyne and Pogostemon). Ludwigia is the red plant in focus, and Cryptocoryne wendtii 'Brown' adds a play of colours to the green. The aquascape has plants in abundant measures - and many of them are quick-growing. That is very helpful in avoiding algae as the aquarium is quickly balanced, but there is also a more frequent need for maintenance with the scissors.

Tip! George started with 7 hours of light per day, and only from 2 T8-tubes the first 4 weeks in order to not accelerate the growth of the plants. After that, 4 T5-tubes and 10 hour lighting periods once the plants had started growing and the aquarium was balanced better.
descriptions_cn: 这是乔治·费尔默打造的水草造景作品，展示在《实用鱼友》杂志中。这个水草造景以荷兰风格为主，大量植物排列成行或成组。许多有茎草品种在结构和颜色上有所不同，营造出视觉效果——同时也带来了挑战。乔治在规划造景时最大的挑战是选择植物和布置位置，确保它们相互协调。他将前景、中景和后景的植物按颜色分类，选择了包括罗贝里和虎耳草在内的经典荷兰水草，以及矮生叉柱花和 pogostemon 等几种新植物。大红叶是造景中的焦点红植，而特罗皮卡温蒂椒草 'Brown' 则为绿色背景增添了色彩变化。造景中植物数量丰富，且许多植物生长迅速。这有助于快速平衡水体，减少藻类的滋生，但同时也需要更频繁地修剪。
提示！乔治最初每天给植物提供7小时光照，前4周仅使用2支T8灯管，以避免植物生长过快。之后，当植物开始生长且水族箱趋于平衡时，改为使用4支T5灯管并延长光照时间至10小时。

detail_list.name: Layout 21
descriptions: A habitat aquarium from Lake Tanganyika with Vallisneria and Tanganyika cichlids. Lake Tanganyika is situated along the western frontier of Tanzania with Congo to the west and Zambia to the south - and like Lake Malawi it is a known habitat within aquaristic. For many years, the aquascaper Jan Hjort Ebdrup has taken an interest in cichlids, both African and South American. The species are: Eretmodus Cyanostictus (mpimbwe), Neolamprologus Multifasciatus, Neolamprologus Leleupi, Neolamprologus Brichardi, Paracyprichromis Nigripinnis, and the sheatfish Synodontis Petricola. In this layout, Jan cheats a little, as he has used the Asian Vallisneria Spiralis 'Tiger' and planted a group of Cryptocoryne x Willisii. None of the plants are native plants of Lake Tanganyika, but in fact the list of native species is long and holds among others Potamogeton, Ottelia and Utricularia species besides Vallisneria, which is the most used genus in Tanganyika biotope aquariums.
Tip! Shells and small conches are excellent hiding places for the cichlids, who also use them for fry.
descriptions_cn: 这是一个坦桑尼亚坦加尼喀湖的水草造景作品，使用了虎纹水兰和坦加尼喀慈鲷。坦加尼喀湖位于坦桑尼亚西部边境，西临刚果，南接赞比亚。该湖是水族界公认的自然栖息地之一，与马拉维湖相似。多年来，造景师詹·厄布德普对慈鲷有着浓厚兴趣，包括非洲和南美种类。该造景中的物种有：Eretmodus Cyanostictus（mpimbwe）、Neolamprologus Multifasciatus、Neolamprologus Leleupi、Neolamprologus Brichardi、Paracyprichromis Nigripinnis 和底栖鱼Synodontis Petricola。在造景中，詹稍微作弊了一点，使用了亚洲的虎纹水兰并种植了一丛威利斯椒草。这些植物都不是坦加尼喀湖的原生植物，但该湖的原生植物种类繁多，包括Potamogeton、Ottelia和Utricularia等属，而虎纹水兰是坦加尼喀生物栖息地造景中最常用的属。
提示！贝壳和小螺壳是慈鲷的理想藏身之处，慈鲷也会利用它们来保护幼鱼。

detail_list.name: Layout 19
descriptions: The size of the aquarium and the choice of easy plants makes it easy to place the aquarium almost anywhere and maintain it with a minimum of time and know-how. All the plants are considerably hardy and most of them grow slowly, which is why there are long periods between the cuttings. The central decoration with the Microsorum-AquaDecor-products in the group of stones and roots gives a depth and play already in the first days. The moss and the crypt is quite capable of growing underneath the shadow of the decoration, and the coloured leaves of Nymphaeas breaks all the green. Nymphaea and Vallisneria must be thinned in leaves and offshoots in order not to shade the other plants, and the floating plant Salvinia can either be reduced regularly or removed 5-6 weeks after the start-up. Basically all companion fish and shoal fish will do very well with all the free space for swimming combined with the opportunity for hiding among dense plants.

Tip! Vallisneria and Salvinia are good examples of supporting plants. The vigorous growth of these plants quickly absorbs e.g. a surplus of nutrients and by that reduces the risk of unrestrained growth of algae in the aquarium.

technique_cn.fertiliser_weekly: 高级液肥 20 ml + 20 ml 专用

descriptions_cn: 这个水草造景作品几乎可以放在任何地方，由于鱼缸大小和选择的易养植物，维护起来非常省时省力。所有植物都相当耐旱，生长速度较慢，因此剪枝间隔时间较长。在石头和根部的组合中加入细叶铁皇冠-AquaDecor产品作为中央装饰，从第一天起就能营造出深度和景深。莫丝和隐头草可以在装饰物的阴影下生长，而睡莲的彩色叶片则打破了绿色的单调。虎斑睡莲和虎纹水兰需要定期修剪叶片和侧枝，以免遮挡其他植物。浮叶植物水鳖可以在启动后5-6周定期减少或移除。几乎所有伴侣鱼和群游鱼都能很好地适应，因为有充足的空间游动和在密集的植物中藏身。
提示！苦草和槐叶萍都是很好的辅助植物。它们生长旺盛，能迅速吸收过剩养分，降低缸内藻类失控生长的风险。

detail_list.name: Layout 18
descriptions: The ideal aquarium for the family room; mom and dad enjoy it as a decorative element, and the children are thrilled about the fish, colours and growth inside the aquarium. Comes with both roots and stones, placed as 2 islands pointing forward and to the middle of the aquarium. The selected plants only require a minimum of care, Echinodorus 'Rubin', Nesaea Crassicaulis and Tiger Lotus brighten up the centre of the aquarium and surround the low Bacopa Australis. On the sides Cryptocoryne and Vallisneria, all growing well along edges, despite the lack of light.
In front, Tenellus will over time create a fleece. Adding "Windeløv" to the large root and behind the stone, results in both depth and movement inside the aquarium.
TIP! Bacopa australis differs from other Bacopa varieties as it remains low and compact.
Note: Plant D on the drawing is Echinodorus 'Rubin' which is no longer produced by Tropica, but can be replaced by another red Echinodorus.
descriptions_cn: 这套造景很适合放在家庭起居室：父母可以把它当作室内装饰，孩子也能观察缸里的鱼、色彩和水草生长。根枝与石材组成两座小岛，走势朝向前方和缸体中央。所选水草维护量都不大；红宝石皇冠草、粗茎水苋和虎斑睡莲提亮中央区域，并环绕着低矮的澳洲虎耳。两侧沿边种植椒草和苦草，即使光线较弱也能正常生长。
在前景，针叶皇冠草会逐渐形成草坪效果。在大块根部前方加入“鹿角铁皇冠”，并在石头后面，既增加了水景的深度又增添了动感。
提示！澳洲虎耳与其他澳洲虎耳品种不同，它保持低矮而紧凑的生长形态。
注意：图纸中的植物 D 是皇冠草 'Rubin'，Tropica 已不再生产，但可以使用另一种红色皇冠草替代。

detail_list.name: Layout 17

technique.fertiliser_weekly: 20 ml Premium Fertiliser + 50 ml Specialised Ferti

descriptions: Here we show a fine layout rich in plants and with both colour and variation - and only with plants where we know that they can grow without addition of CO2. The central piece of wood is placed as a tree, and along the roots it runs out to rocks. The tree top is made of moss, and Vallisneria and Crypts are planted in the cracks between wood and rocks - both plants that do well when overshadowed. Hygrophila difformis is fast growing and easy - and in the other side gives Ludwigia and Bacopa a beautiful colour contrast. Over time should Bacopa be trimmed lower down than Ludwigia so both plants can be seen from the front. Tenellus is planted in small tufts along the rock edges.

Tip! Many bunches such as Hygrophila difformis are fast growing - and inexpensive! Fast growing plants help you when you start up the aquarium. When the aquarium is in balance, you can always remove the bunch plant and add a new plant instead.

technique_cn.fertiliser_weekly: 20 ml Premium Fertiliser + 50 ml Specialised Fertiliser

descriptions_cn: 这里展示了一个植物丰富、色彩多样且变化多端的水草造景。我们只使用了能够自然生长的植物，无需额外添加 CO₂。中央的木头被放置成一棵树的形状，根部延伸至石头上。树顶用莫丝覆盖，木头和石头之间的缝隙中种植了苦草和Crypts，这些植物在被遮挡时也能良好生长。水罗兰生长迅速且容易养护，在另一侧与鲁宾叶底红和虎耳草形成美丽的色彩对比。随着时间的推移，虎耳草应修剪得比鲁宾叶底红低，以便从正面观赏到两种植物。针叶皇冠草被种植在岩石边缘的小丛中。
提示！像水罗兰这样的丛生植物生长迅速且价格便宜！快速生长的植物在造景缸启动初期非常有帮助。当造景缸达到平衡后，你可以移除旧的丛生植物并换上新的植物。

detail_list.name: Layout 16
descriptions: Here we show you how to do an aquarium "here and now" - even though it is your first aquarium! We use primarily AquaDecor-products where plants have been grown on the wood or rock, and supplies with few pots of Echinodorus and Vallisneria. In one side of the aquarium, we have placed a large piece of wood with two Anubias, and in the other side pieces of wood with respectively Microsorum and Anubias. Centrally, a rock with Pogostemon helferi breaks with lighter green colour and curly leaves. In front is placed a narrow wood piece with moss. A half coconut with plants creates decoration and a hiding space for fish. Vallisneria and Echinodorus in the background add volume and are fast growing plants.
Tip! Use of AquaDecor give a quick result - and have only a minor maintenance! Most of the plants used on AquaDecor are slow growing and thereby have less need for maintenance.
Note: Plant F on the drawing is a half coconut planted with Anubias and moss, which is no longer produced by Tropica.
descriptions_cn: 这是如何在你的第一个水族箱中完成水草造景的一次展示！我们主要使用AquaDecor产品，这些植物是在木头上或石头上生长的，配有少量红香瓜草和大水兰的盆栽。在水族箱的一侧，放置了一块大木头，上面有两株水榕；另一侧则有分别放置铁皇冠和水榕的木头。中央位置是一块石头，上面有喷泉太阳，呈现出较浅的绿色和卷曲的叶片。前方放置了一块窄木头，上面有莫丝。一个半椰子壳中种植着植物，作为装饰并为鱼类提供藏身之处。背景中的大水兰和红香瓜草增加了体积，且生长迅速。
提示！使用 AquaDecor 可以快速见效，并且维护工作量较小！AquaDecor 使用的大部分植物生长较慢，因此对维护的需求也较少。
注意：图纸上的植物 F 是用水榕和莫丝种植的半椰子，Tropica 已经不再生产了。

detail_list.name: Layout 15
descriptions: The aquarium in the children's room with the ship wreck, a diver, skeleton and lost treasures - the possibilities are many when choosing decorations! And it is easy to find plants which can help to represent the picture and create the necessary balance in the aquarium. We have chosen Egeria and Vallisneria which both can represent seaweeds. Algae balls are placed randomly as tufts on the coral reef, and Monosolenium are very much like Sea salad which you often find along the beach at summertime. All chosen plants are easy and do well even at the low light conditions as the chosen aquarium offer the plants!

Tip! The Bala shark (Pangasios) is a short-term choice for this layout, as it becomes too big for the aquarium over time. Please also add algae eating fish and inverts i.e. Otocinclus affinis and Cherry shrimp.
descriptions_cn: 儿童房里的水族箱中有一艘沉船、潜水员、骨架和失落的宝藏——选择装饰品的可能性很多！很容易找到能帮助表现画面并创造必要平衡的水草。我们选择了水蕴草和小水兰，这两种植物都能代表海藻。藻球随机放置在珊瑚礁上作为小丛，而珊瑚莫丝则非常像夏季海滩边常有的海白菜。所有选择的植物在低光照条件下也容易生长且表现良好，因为选择的水族箱为植物提供了理想的生长条件！
提示！这条纹鲨（Pangasius）在这个造景中只是短期选择，因为它会随着时间长大到不适合这个水族箱。请添加一些藻食性鱼和无脊椎动物，例如奥托吸盘鱼（Otocinclus affinis）和红樱桃虾。

detail_list.name: Layout 10
descriptions: The show aquarium is rich in plants, in fish and colours - and is placed in the living room where the whole family is enriched by the aquarium on a daily basis. Many plants in the aquarium shows that there is also space for a high abundance of fish, in this case, Discus. Heteranthera dominates in the left side of the aquarium while Bacopa makes the background in the right side. Several types of coloured stem plants are placed in the midground which creates an elegant colour contrast to the green background. Marsilea creates a carpet in the foreground and helps to keep a healthy balance in the aquarium.
Tip! The stem plants has to be trimmed often to ensure that the down shadow out other plants. Note: Plant C on the drawing is Nesaea pedicellata which is no longer produced by Tropica.
descriptions_cn: 这个水草造景作品丰富多样，鱼种和色彩繁多，放置在客厅中，全家人都能每天享受观赏的乐趣。水族箱中种植了众多水草，表明这里也有足够的空间容纳大量鱼类，具体来说是丽鱼科鱼。左侧水草区以罗丝草为主，右侧背景则由虎耳草占据。中景摆放了几种彩色有茎草，与绿色背景形成优雅的色彩对比。澳洲田字草在前景形成草坪，有助于维持水族箱内的健康平衡。
提示！有茎草需要经常修剪，以确保其下部的阴影不会遮挡其他植物。注意：图纸中的植物 C 为 Nesaea pedicellata，Tropica 已不再生产此品种。

detail_list.name: Layout 9
descriptions: The 1-2-GROW! aquarium is a 30L aquarium with plants taken directly from our laboratory. When its vegetation was 3 months old, the aquarium was presented at Interzoo 2010 where we also exhibited the aquarium with newly-planted vegetation for a comparison of plant growth over time. The decoration of the aquarium is made up of three pieces of rock and Hygrophila 'Rosanervig' which is planted behind the rocks and creates a wonderful play of colours. Staurogyne grows on both sides of the rocks in dense, compact formations and a carpet of Glossostigma is cultivated in front. The 1-2-GROW! products are extremely well-suited also to smaller aquariums as their growth is more compact. Even if there are no algae present among the plants on planting, we still recommend that you use shrimps and algae-eating fish in order to continuously keep the aquarium free of algae.

Tip! 1-2-GROW! products are slower starters as they have a smaller "meal package" from the nursery compared to normal pot plants. This is why they require more care - you should start using small amounts of fertilizer already after they have been in the aquarium for a couple of days.
descriptions_cn: 1-2-GROW! 水族箱是一个 30L 的水族箱，箱内植物直接来自我们的实验室。当植物生长到 3 个月时，我们于 2010 年的 Interzoo 展览会上展示了这个水族箱，并同时展示了新种植的植物以对比植物的生长情况。水族箱的装饰由三块石头和红丝青叶组成，红丝青叶种植在石头后面，营造出美丽的色彩对比。矮生叉柱花在石头两侧密集生长，形成紧凑的群落，而矮珍珠则在前景形成草坪。1-2-GROW! 产品非常适合小型水族箱，因为它们的生长更为紧凑。即使在种植时没有藻类，我们仍建议使用虾和清道鱼来持续保持水族箱无藻。
提示！1-2-GROW! 产品生长较慢，因为它们从育苗阶段得到的营养较少，相比普通盆栽植物来说“餐包”更小。因此需要更多的照顾，你应该在这些植物入缸两三天后就开始使用少量的液肥。

detail_list.name: Layout 8

technique.fertiliser_weekly: 40 ml Premium Fertiliser + 80 ml Specialised Ferti

descriptions: The bridge of moss is specially made for the Interzoo 2010 to present Tropica's new web site. The bridge of moss is made out of weeping moss. The moss is tied to the roots using cotton thread which combines the two islands in the aquarium. Both of the islands contain Myriophyllum mattogrossense in the back ground (rapid growth, larger) and Myriophyllum mezianum in the front (smaller and is slow growing). Echinodorus tenellus form a carpet from side to side in the aquarium. Central in the aquarium is a group of Ludwigia glandulosa, an example of an easy red stem plant which can be kept in a tight compact group.
Tip! Frequent pruning of stem plants promotes shorter distance between the set of leaves (more compact growth) and often also longer/smaller leaves.
Note: Plant C on the drawing is Myriophyllum mezianum which is no longer produced by Tropica. Can be replaced by Myriophyllum tuberculatum.

technique_cn.fertiliser_weekly: 40 ml Premium Fertiliser + 80 ml Specialised Fertiliser

descriptions_cn: 这段文字描述了一个水草造景作品的介绍。莫丝桥是为了2010年Interzoo展会特别制作，用于展示Tropica的新网站。莫丝桥由垂泪莫丝制成，用棉线将莫丝绑在根部，连接起水族箱中的两个岛屿。两个岛屿的后景都种植了雪花羽毛（生长迅速，植株较大），前景则种植了较小且生长缓慢的雪花羽毛mezianum。针叶皇冠草在水族箱中形成一片草坪。水族箱中央是一组大红叶，这是一种容易养护的红色有茎草，可以紧密地成群种植。
提示！经常修剪有茎草可以促进叶片间距缩短（更紧凑的生长）并且通常使叶片变得更长更小。
注意：图纸中的植物 C 是雪花羽毛 mezianum，Tropica 已不再生产这种植物。可以用雪花羽毛 tuberculatum 替换。

detail_list.name: Layout 7
descriptions: "Nature's Privilege" is aquascaped by Graeme Edwards from the UK Aquatic Plant Society (UKAPS) and is inspired by impressions from nature in the north-western part of England. It is the vigorous green carpet of Marsilea in the foreground and with a central rock formation where roots run from cracks in the rocks. Between the rock and the carpet smaller rock pieces are covered with Christmas moss. Centrally in the rock formation, groups with Polygonum and Hygrophila pinnatifida are placed, and Micorosorum and Bolbitis are attached to the roots. Small portions of Eleocharis simulate grass from nature. Hydrocotyle runs over the ground on the rear sides of the rock formation.
Note: Plant B on the drawing is Polygonum sp. which is no longer produced by Tropica.
descriptions_cn: “Nature’s Privilege” 是由英国水生植物协会（UK Aquatic Plant Society, UKAPS）的 Graeme Edwards 打造的水草造景作品，灵感来源于英格兰西北部的自然景观。前景是茂盛的澳洲田字草草坪，中央有一组岩石，岩石缝隙中生长着根系。在岩石之间覆盖着圣诞莫丝。岩石中央放置了 Polygonum 和羽裂水蓑衣的群植，黑木蕨和 Micorosorum 粘附在根部。牛毛毡模拟自然中的草地，分布在岩石后侧的地面。三裂天胡荽则在岩石后侧的地面上蔓延生长。
注意：图纸中的植物 B 是 Polygonum sp.，Tropica 已经不再生产这种植物。

detail_list.name: Layout 5
descriptions: Over the last few years nano aquariums have become very popular. Partly because they fit well into the modern family's way of living and also because the use of different mosses and shrimps are a growing trend. This layout is more advanced and requires both good light and CO2.

Three different foreground plants have been used for this layout. All with different leaf shapes. Hemianthus with its millimeter-sized leaves that capture tiny oxygen bubbles, Staurogyne with slightly bigger leaves and a creeping growth, and finally Pogostemon that creates dense, curly leaves. Behind the stony soil a Heteranthera contribute with plumpness and vigor. Many plants are suitable for the nano aquariums and especially mosses are popular! Most plant types are suitable, but frequently cutting is a must if you use taller and fast growing plants.
Tip! Small algae-eating fish and shrimps, frequent water changes and regular care are important elements to maintain an optimal water quality in your nano aquarium.
descriptions_cn: 近年来，微水族箱变得非常受欢迎。这 partly 因为它们很适合现代家庭的生活方式，也因为使用不同种类的莫丝和虾类越来越流行。这个造景构图更为高级，需要良好的光照和 CO₂。
这个造景使用了三种不同的前景植物，每种叶子形状都不同。珍珠草的叶子只有毫米大小，能捕捉到细小的氧气泡；矮生叉柱花的叶子稍大一些，呈匍匐生长；最后是 pogostemon，它能长出密集的卷曲叶子。在石质底床后面，罗丝草提供了丰满和活力。许多植物都适合用于小型水族箱，尤其是莫丝非常受欢迎！大多数植物种类都适用，但如果你使用高大的快速生长植物，必须经常修剪。
提示！在纳米水族箱中，定期喂食小型藻类鱼和虾、频繁换水和常规维护是保持最佳水质的重要因素。

detail_list.name: Layout 4
descriptions: Some of the main considerations when planting the children's aquarium are colours, impact and action. We have chosen a dinosaur/animal layout for this set-up, but you can find a large selection of ornaments at your local shop such as pirates, castles, treasure chests, sunken ships etc. In order to ensure the correct balance in the children's aquarium you will definitely need plants! The number of plants must be adjusted to the number of fish. It should be plants that easily adapt to the environment and that help the water to stay clean and algae free. Below we listed a selection of both fast and slow growing species that are all good starter plants.

TIP! Buy livebearing fish for the children's aquarium such as guppies and platies. They are hardy, brightly coloured and breed frequently. They also eat algae. Ask your local dealer for further information.
descriptions_cn: 在种植儿童水族箱时，主要考虑的是颜色、冲击感和动态效果。我们选择了恐龙/动物风格的造景，但您可以在当地商店找到海盗、城堡、宝箱、沉船等装饰品。为了确保儿童水族箱的正确平衡，您肯定需要种植植物！植物的数量应根据鱼的数量进行调整。这些植物应能适应环境，帮助保持水质清洁无藻。以下是快速和慢速生长的几种适合作为入门植物的种类。
提示！为孩子们的水族箱购买活生鱼，如孔雀鱼和月光鱼。这些鱼生命力强，色彩鲜艳，繁殖频繁，还能吃藻类。请咨询当地供应商以获取更多信息。

detail_list.name: Layout 3
descriptions: The Aquarium for plant lovers! This aquarium contains a large number of plants, it's colourful, contains new plants and has an impressing layout with rocks and "spider-like roots". We show with this layout how transitions can be made entirely from low foreground plants to rock formations and how to create a wedge between the rocks by using medium high plants. We use Vallisneria as an easy carpet in the background. Space is created for the Echinodorus 'Ozelot' that may be the most beautiful, coloured Echinodorus in the aquarium. Christmas moss has been attached to the roots and helps to creating depth and a sense of maturity in the aquarium.

Tip! Carpets of foreground plants help to maintain a good balance in the aquarium and need to be maintained regularly. There are many suitable species; Eleocharis, Lilaeopsis, Echinodorus tenellus… the list is long!
descriptions_cn: 这是一个为水草爱好者打造的缸！缸内水草种类丰富、色彩鲜明，也采用了不少新品种；石材与蜘蛛般伸展的根枝共同组成醒目的骨架。这个造景展示了如何让低矮的前景草自然过渡到石组，并利用中等高度的水草在石间形成楔形层次。后景以容易养护的苦草铺陈，同时为豹纹皇冠草留出足够空间——它或许是缸中颜色最漂亮的一株皇冠草。圣诞莫丝绑在根枝上，为画面增加纵深，也让造景显得更加成熟。
提示！前景草坪有助于维持水族箱的良好平衡，需要定期维护。有许多合适的种类，如迷你牛毛毡、南美草皮、针叶皇冠草……种类繁多！

detail_list.name: Layout 2
descriptions: An example of an aquarium that will fit in several settings: The living room, the kitchen or in your office. This layout is classic because of its island composition. The foreground is a thriving carpet of Lilaeopsis and the colorful 'Rosanervig' is the focal point of the aquarium. By planting Anubias and Cryptocoryne in the middle of the aquarium will create a contrast of dark green to the bright green carpet and the colorful 'Rosanervig'. Java moss attached to wood will create both depth and maturity. The composition of plants provides a fine balance between fast growing plants (they take up nutrient and reduce algae growth) and slow growing plants that require less maintaining.
TIP! 'Rosanervig' is an undemanding plant. Nesaea crassicaulis or Rotala rotundifolia are suitable alternatives as easy and coloured plants.
descriptions_cn: 这是一个适合多种场合的水草造景作品：客厅、厨房或办公室。此构图因其岛屿布局而显得经典。前景是一片茂盛的南美尖叶草皮，而色彩鲜艳的“红丝青叶”则是观赏焦点。在水族箱中部种植水榕和贝克椒草，形成深绿色与亮绿色草皮的对比。附着在木材上的爪哇莫丝则增加了深度和成熟感。植物的搭配提供了良好的平衡，快速生长的植物吸收养分减少藻类生长，而慢生植物则减少了维护工作。
提示！“红丝青叶”是一种不挑环境的植物。Nesaea crassicaulis 或红宫廷是合适的替代选择，它们是容易养护且颜色鲜艳的有茎草。

detail_list.name: Layout 1
descriptions: In most pet shops it's easy to find a starter aquarium kit. It is a complete set containing aquarium, light, heater and filter. Most beginners would like a thriving aquarium with bold colours and a large number of fish. However, experience shows that a starter kit often provides low lighting levels so there are only few plants suitable to this type of aquarium. We have for this set-up chosen standard plants only! Microsorum and Cryptocoryne are both slow growing and Echinodorus and Vallisneria to create volume in the aquarium. Limnophila is centrally planted, right under the light and is an example of a plant that grows fast and which helps creating a good balance in the aquarium.

TIP! By using AquaDecor products with plants like Microsorum and Anubias for the set-up, the aquarium will look more adapted from the start. These products are already well established on root or lavastone.
descriptions_cn: 在大多数宠物店，很容易找到入门水族箱套装。套装包含水族箱、灯光、加热器和过滤器。大多数初学者希望拥有色彩鲜艳、鱼儿众多的水族箱。然而，经验表明，入门套装通常提供较低的光照强度，因此适合这种水族箱的植物种类很少。为此布局，我们只选择了标准植物！鹿角铁皇冠和椒草生长缓慢，亚马逊皇冠草和小水兰用于增加水族箱的体积。小宝塔被中央种植在灯光下，是生长迅速的植物，有助于在水族箱中创造良好的平衡。
提示！使用AquaDecor产品搭配鹿角铁皇冠和水榕进行造景，可以让水族箱从一开始就显得更加自然适应。这些产品已经在根或熔岩石上生长得非常好。
